pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Adaptive Vision
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: After years of using black powder weaponry in dimly lit spaces, you've become accustomed to dazzling flashes of light and sudden shifts in illumination.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: After years of using black powder weaponry in dimly lit spaces, you've become accustomed to dazzling flashes of light and sudden shifts in illumination. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against visual effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a visual effect, you get a critical success instead.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Adaptive Vision

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Aeonbound
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your lineage is influenced or directly tied to the supernatural inhabitants of the Perfect City of the plane of law, a realm of pure and absolute order.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your lineage is influenced or directly tied to the supernatural inhabitants of the Perfect City of the plane of law, a realm of pure and absolute order. This energy suffuses your body and helps it maintain coherency, resisting effects that would undermine your function or mar your otherwise orderly form. You and your allies can Treat your Wounds without a healer's toolkit. Once per day, when someone rolls a failure or a critical failure on a check to Treat your Wounds, you can focus on your internal cohesion to increase the degree of success by one step.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Aeonbound

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Arcane Communication
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can deliver silent messages.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You can deliver silent messages. You gain touch telepathy, allowing you to communicate silently and mentally with any creature you're touching, as long as you share a language.

**Enhancement** You can send your messages even further. Your telepathy gains a range of 10 feet, but you still have to share a language with your target.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Arcane Communication

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Arcane Eye
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your eye has been magically enhanced to pierce darkness.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Your eye has been magically enhanced to pierce darkness. You gain darkvision.

**Enhancement** Your eye can see invisible creatures in brief spurts. You can cast See the Unseen as an arcane innate spell once per hour.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Arcane Eye

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Artisanal Crafter
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Like many minotaurs, you take pride in creating items made from stone or metal.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Like many minotaurs, you take pride in creating items made from stone or metal. You become trained in Crafting (or another skill of your choice, if you're already trained in Crafting) and gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat in your choice of blacksmithing, leatherworking, or stonemasonry.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Artisanal Crafter

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Athamaru Lore
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've immersed yourself in community learning, particularly around navigating the waters and tending to animals.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You've immersed yourself in community learning, particularly around navigating the waters and tending to animals. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Athletics and Nature. If you automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Athamaru Lore.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Athamaru Lore

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Athamaru Weapon Familiarity
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You wield weapons designed to work underwater with ease.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You wield weapons designed to work underwater with ease. You have familiarity with weapons with the athamaru trait and with crossbows, heavy crossbows, longspears, spears, and tridents—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Athamaru Weapon Familiarity

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Automaton Armament
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've been provided a body part designed for combat.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You've been provided a body part designed for combat. You gain either a claw or pincer unarmed attack. The claw deals 1d4 slashing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits. The pincer deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the grapple and unarmed traits. Your body can be reconfigured; you can select this feat at any level, and you can retrain into or out of this feat or change the type of attack you gain.

**Enhancement** Your attacking part is reinforced. Increase the damage die of the unarmed attack you gain from this feat by one step (from 1d4 to 1d6, or from 1d6 to 1d8).
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Automaton Armament

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Automaton Lore
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You have come to better understand the process that made your body and the magic that powers it.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You have come to better understand the process that made your body and the magic that powers it. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Arcana and Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore feat for Automaton Lore.

**Enhancement** Your gain greater understanding. Increase your proficiency rank in your choice of either Arcana or Crafting to expert. If you were already an expert in the chosen skill, increase your rank to master instead.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Automaton Lore

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Awakened Animal Lore
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You have taken the time to learn about the process of awakening and the experiences of your fellow awakened animals.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You have taken the time to learn about the process of awakening and the experiences of your fellow awakened animals. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Arcana and Nature. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Awakened Animal Lore.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Awakened Animal Lore

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Awakened Magic
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: When you awakened, primal magic was released within you.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: When you awakened, primal magic was released within you. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this spell as an primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Awakened Magic

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Battleblooded
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You descend from those whose lives were touched by legendary einherjars, who were crafted from the souls of mighty warriors slain in battle and chosen by valkyries to serve as foot soldiers to many…
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You descend from those whose lives were touched by legendary einherjars, who were crafted from the souls of mighty warriors slain in battle and chosen by valkyries to serve as foot soldiers to many gods. You may even be the distant mortal descendant of an actual valkyrie.

You are trained in Intimidation. If you were already trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Battleblooded

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Caretaker's Intuition
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your forebears had a deep understanding of the natural world around them, and you've learned some of their knowledge and techniques.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Your forebears had a deep understanding of the natural world around them, and you've learned some of their knowledge and techniques. You are trained in Nature. If you would automatically become trained in Nature (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

Additionally, while outdoors, you can spend 10 minutes to read the sky and determine upcoming weather. You get a general impression of weather up to 8 hours in advance. You can use this to determine that clear skies or a rainstorm are ahead, but you can't determine specifics like wind speeds and direction, or that a tornado would be occurring later.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Caretaker's Intuition

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Caretaker's Restoration
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: The stewarding abilities of your forebears allows you to repair objects important to you.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** An item you're holding, wearing, or wielding becomes broken but not destroyed.

The stewarding abilities of your forebears allows you to repair objects important to you. The triggering item is restored to a number of Hit Points that is 1 higher than its Broken Threshold. For example, a steel shield with a Broken Threshold of 10 is restored to 11 Hit Points.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Caretaker's Restoration

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Cattle Speech
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can understand the lowing of cattle and similar animals as its own language.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You can understand the lowing of cattle and similar animals as its own language. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with cattle, bison, antelopes, and other grazing mammals that travel in herds. The GM determines which other animals count for this ability.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Cattle Speech

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Centaur Lore
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've learned how to nurture your environment and to care for your people.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You've learned how to nurture your environment and to care for your people. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Medicine and Nature. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Centaur Lore.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Centaur Lore

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Centaur Weapon Familiarity
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've trained in the weapons favored by your people, becoming a skilled archer and jouster.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You've trained in the weapons favored by your people, becoming a skilled archer and jouster. You have familiarity with the lance, longbow, longspear, shortbow, and spear—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Centaur Weapon Familiarity

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Clan Pistol
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You get one clan pistol of your clan for free, as it was given to you at birth.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You get one clan pistol of your clan for free, as it was given to you at birth. This replaces your clan dagger. Selling this pistol is a terrible taboo and earns you the disdain of other dwarves. You are trained with the clan pistol.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Clan Pistol

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Clone-Risen
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You were formed from a clone ritual or alchemical experiment.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You were formed from a clone ritual or alchemical experiment. Created as a vessel for another creature, you can suppress your sentience momentarily, making your mind harder to alter. You gain the Empty Vessel reaction.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Clone-Risen

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Community-Minded
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You are familiar with all the members of your community and their typical movements, and you have learned how to apply these patterns outside those circles.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You are familiar with all the members of your community and their typical movements, and you have learned how to apply these patterns outside those circles. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC against someone attempting to Lie to you and to Perception checks to Sense Motive or to detect a creature trying to Impersonate someone they are not.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Community-Minded

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Coral Symbiotes
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've tended to your coral jewelry so well that you have formed a symbiotic relationship with it.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've tended to your coral jewelry so well that you have formed a symbiotic relationship with it. The powerful filtration properties of this coral protect you from impurities. You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against poisons, and your flat check to remove persistent poison damage is DC 10 instead of DC 15, which is reduced to DC 5 if another creature uses a particularly appropriate action to help. You must submerge yourself in water once every 24 hours to hydrate your coral or you lose the bonuses granted by the symbiotes.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Coral Symbiotes

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Creative Prodigy
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You have a powerful creative drive that is clear to any who interact with you.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You have a powerful creative drive that is clear to any who interact with you. You are trained in Performance. If you were already trained in Performance (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Impressive Performance skill feat, and when you use Performance Make An Impression, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the check.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Creative Prodigy

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Elver Pet
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Athamarus have bonded with eels more closely than any other fish.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Athamarus have bonded with eels more closely than any other fish. You have formed a strong connection with a young eel that serves as your pet. Typically, these eels are tended until they grow large enough to serve as a mount. You gain the Pet general feat. Instead of the normal choice of pet abilities, your eel has aquatic, Fast Movement, and the Damage Avoidance familiar ability for Reflex saves. The aquatic ability means it gains the aquatic trait, breathes water instead of air, and has a swim Speed instead of a land Speed.

When you aren't in an aquatic environment, you can easily carry your pet eel around in a small water-filled globe that has light Bulk.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Elver Pet

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Emit Defensive Odor
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: While athamarus' natural pheromones are typically used for communication, you have developed yours into a defense mechanism to ward off foes.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

While athamarus' natural pheromones are typically used for communication, you have developed yours into a defense mechanism to ward off foes. You emit a thick spray of defensive pheromones at an adjacent creature, who takes level-based poison damage with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Emit Defensive Odor

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Energy Beam
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can channel your core's power through the magical gem that serves as your eye.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You can channel your core's power through the magical gem that serves as your eye. You gain an energy beam ranged unarmed attack that deals 1d4 fire damage. The energy beam has a range increment of 20 feet. On a critical hit, the target takes persistent fire damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice. Your eye beam does not add critical specialization effects.

**Enhancement** You channel greater power. Increase the damage die of your energy beam by one step, from 1d4 to 1d6.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Energy Beam

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Explosive Savant
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've spent a lifetime wielding guns and explosive ordinance.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've spent a lifetime wielding guns and explosive ordinance. You have familiarity with bombs and firearms; for the purposes of proficiency you treat bombs and martial firearms as simple weapons, and advanced firearms as martial weapons.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Explosive Savant

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Expressive Face
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your face is constructed to move organically and show your emotions, making you more relatable to organic creatures.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Your face is constructed to move organically and show your emotions, making you more relatable to organic creatures. You become trained in Diplomacy. If you are already trained in Diplomacy, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. Additionally, you gain the Glad-Hand skill feat, even if you do not meet its prerequisites.

**Enhancement** You are particularly skilled at pouring your heart out to others. You gain the Plaintive Plea action.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Expressive Face

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Eye for Masonry
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your familiarity with architecture allows you to easily spot subtle stonework.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Your familiarity with architecture allows you to easily spot subtle stonework. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to notice unusual stonework. This bonus applies to checks to discover mechanical traps made of stone or hidden within stone, as well as secret doors in stone.

When using Athletics to Force Open a stone door or Thievery to Disable a Device made primarily of stone, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to that check.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Eye for Masonry

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Fascinated by Society
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Just as some humanoids find themselves driven to study nature, you are obsessed with the artificial constructs of society and can't get enough.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Just as some humanoids find themselves driven to study nature, you are obsessed with the artificial constructs of society and can't get enough. You are trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

As a newcomer, sometimes your understanding is a bit off target. When you fail, but don't critically fail, a Society check to Recall Knowledge or Decipher Writing, you learn the correct information (as you would on a success) and erroneous information (as you would on a critical failure). You don't have any way to differentiate which is which.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Fascinated by Society

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Faultspawn
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You bear a grudge, inherited from a blasphemous asura forebear in your bloodline, against a particular deity and their works.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You bear a grudge, inherited from a blasphemous asura forebear in your bloodline, against a particular deity and their works.

You gain the Find Fault reaction.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Faultspawn

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Fire Savvy
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've grown up around a forge and are well-suited to dealing with smoke and flame.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've grown up around a forge and are well-suited to dealing with smoke and flame. Your flat check to remove persistent fire damage is DC 10 instead of DC 15, which is reduced to DC 5 with appropriate assistance. In addition, if you roll a success on a saving throw against suffocation or choking due to smoke or ash, you get a critical success instead.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Fire Savvy

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Friendly Nudge
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You don't always have time to wait for your allies to make room, so it's best to politely move them yourself.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You don't always have time to wait for your allies to make room, so it's best to politely move them yourself. Attempt an Athletics check to Shove an ally. You don't need to have a free hand to attempt this check. If your ally is willing, treat the result as one degree of success higher.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Friendly Nudge

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Intuitive Crafting
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your affinity with process and order makes you a natural artisan.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Your affinity with process and order makes you a natural artisan. You are trained in Crafting. If you were already trained in Crafting, you instead gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat in a specialty of your choice; if you have both, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, when you critically fail to Repair an item, you get a failure instead.

*Note: If you were already trained in Crafting, you need to manually add the Specialty Crafting feat or select an alternative skill.*
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Intuitive Crafting

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Irrepressible (Nephilim)
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your slight otherworldly nature allows you to easily brush off emotional manipulation.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your slight otherworldly nature allows you to easily brush off emotional manipulation. When you roll a success on a save against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Irrepressible (Nephilim)

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Jotun's Eyes
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your vision has adapted to the darkness between planes.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your vision has adapted to the darkness between planes. You gain darkvision.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Jotun's Eyes

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Jotunborn Grappler
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Wrestling is a common pastime for jotunborn, and you've done your fair share.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Wrestling is a common pastime for jotunborn, and you've done your fair share. You are trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Titan Wrestler skill feat.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Jotunborn Grappler

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Jotunborn Lore
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You were taught the history of your people's planar travels as well as the skills necessary to thrive in sub-planar environments.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You were taught the history of your people's planar travels as well as the skills necessary to thrive in sub-planar environments. You become trained in Occultism and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Jotunborn Lore.

**Special** If you have the Sage Jotunborn heritage, you gain the Additional Lore feat a second time for a lore of your choice.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Jotunborn Lore

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Jotunborn Weapon Familiarity
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the jotunborn trait.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the jotunborn trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the jotunborn trait plus the bola, greataxe, halberd, maul, longspear, and war flail—for the purpose of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Jotunborn Weapon Familiarity

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Keen Nose
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Accustomed to the foul air of underground tunnels, your sense of smell is sharpened, and noxious scents are less offensive.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Accustomed to the foul air of underground tunnels, your sense of smell is sharpened, and noxious scents are less offensive. You gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against olfactory effects that cause the sickened condition.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Keen Nose

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Land Legs
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You are comfortable on land for a short time.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You are comfortable on land for a short time. You gain a land Speed of 20 and can breathe air for 10 minutes.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Land Legs

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Learn by Watching
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Before your awakening, you watched humanoids performing some skill near you frequently.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Before your awakening, you watched humanoids performing some skill near you frequently. You didn't know it at the time, but your curiosity led to you picking up the skill. You become trained in your choice of Crafting, Medicine, or Performance. In addition, when you Follow the Expert in exploration mode, you add 2 + your level as your proficiency bonus if you're untrained instead of adding your level alone.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Learn by Watching

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Merfolk Lore
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You paid close attention to your lessons in school.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You paid close attention to your lessons in school. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Arcana and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore feat for Merfolk Lore.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Merfolk Lore

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Merfolk Weapon Familiarity
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You were taught the most effective weapons of the sea.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You were taught the most effective weapons of the sea. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the merfolk trait. You have familiarity with crossbows, heavy crossbows, longspears, spears, and tridents—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Merfolk Weapon Familiarity

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Messenger
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You were built with a special ability to relay private messages to your fellow automatons, but you can luckily use it with anyone you would like.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You were built with a special ability to relay private messages to your fellow automatons, but you can luckily use it with anyone you would like. You gain message as an innate arcane cantrip.

**Enhancement** You can target up to five creatures at once when you cast message.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Messenger

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Minotaur Lore
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You were raised in a minotaur enclave or have spent a great deal of time studying your culture and ancestry.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You were raised in a minotaur enclave or have spent a great deal of time studying your culture and ancestry. You become trained in Society and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Minotaur Lore.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Minotaur Lore

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Minotaur Weapon Familiarity
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your elders taught you to wield weapons that can split skulls and smash through shields.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Your elders taught you to wield weapons that can split skulls and smash through shields. You have familiarity with the battle axe, falchion, glaive, and greataxe—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat these martial weapons as simple weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Minotaur Weapon Familiarity

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Mirror-Risen
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You were created from magic involving mirrors and still retain some ability to seek refuge in reflected illusions.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You were created from magic involving mirrors and still retain some ability to seek refuge in reflected illusions. You gain the Mirror-Trickery reaction.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Mirror-Risen

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Morph-Risen
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You were once a shapeshifter or spellcaster using polymorph magic, but something went wrong, and you became trapped in the form of the creature you were imitating.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You were once a shapeshifter or spellcaster using polymorph magic, but something went wrong, and you became trapped in the form of the creature you were imitating. This accident might have drained your power, or you might have retained some of your skills, but either way, your form resists further forced transformation. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against morph and polymorph effects, and if you roll a success on a saving throw against a hostile morph or polymorph effect, you get a critical success instead.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Morph-Risen

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Natural Senses
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You have retained your sharp animal senses even after awakening.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You have retained your sharp animal senses even after awakening. Choose one of the following senses appropriate to your kind of animal: darkvision, echolocation 10 feet, low-light vision, scent (imprecise) 30 feet, or tremorsense (imprecise) 30 feet. (Echolocation allows you to use hearing as a precise sense at the listed range.) If your animal kind doesn't typically have a specific type of sense, you can't gain that sense with this feat.

**Special** You can take this feat multiple times, choosing a different sense each time.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Natural Senses

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Ocean Wariness
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Stories about those who have mistreated your people in the past (particularly stories about alghollthu mind control) left you untrusting of those outside your community.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Stories about those who have mistreated your people in the past (particularly stories about alghollthu mind control) left you untrusting of those outside your community. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your defenses against Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Performance checks.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Ocean Wariness

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Ocean's Bite
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your jaws open wider than a humanoid mouth should, showing off multiple rows of serrated shark teeth or a viperfish-like nest of needles.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your jaws open wider than a humanoid mouth should, showing off multiple rows of serrated shark teeth or a viperfish-like nest of needles. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Ocean's Bite

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Pantheon Magic
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: The touch of divine meddling still runs through you, whether you want it or not.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: The touch of divine meddling still runs through you, whether you want it or not. Choose one cantrip from the divine spell list. You can cast this cantrip as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Pantheon Magic

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Pheromonal Message
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your communicative pheromones are particularly well developed from years of living with other athamarus.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your communicative pheromones are particularly well developed from years of living with other athamarus. You send a brief message to one ally within 60 feet, or 120 feet in water. No other creature can understand the message. The message must be short and simple, and can't convey ideas that would require complex or novel wording if spoken, such a creature's name or proper nouns.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Pheromonal Message

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Plane-Stepping Dash
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You move with magical swiftness, treading between planar boundaries to shorten your journey.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You move with magical swiftness, treading between planar boundaries to shorten your journey. Stride once; this Stride does not trigger reactions normally triggered by movement.

Once this Stride is complete, you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed until the start of your next turn.

Effect: Plane-Stepping Dash
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Plane-Stepping Dash

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Powerful Tail
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You resemble an animal or a type of humanoid who has a tail.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You resemble an animal or a type of humanoid who has a tail. You gain a tail unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage. This tail is in the brawling group.

**Enhancement** Your tail is not only powerful but also flexible. You gain a climb Speed of 10 feet, and you reduce the number of free hands required to Climb or Trip by one.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Powerful Tail

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Practiced Brawn
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You're accustomed to long days filled with hard physical labor.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You're accustomed to long days filled with hard physical labor. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Force Open and Shove, and to Fortitude saving throws to resist becoming fatigued. When you roll a success on an Athletics check to Shove, you get a critical success instead.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Practiced Brawn

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Progenitor Lore
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You didn't just inherit your physical form from your progenitor; you also retained some of their knowledge.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You didn't just inherit your physical form from your progenitor; you also retained some of their knowledge. You're trained in Deception and Occultism. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in a Lore corresponding to your ancestry (e. g., Elf Lore if your progenitor is an elf).
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Progenitor Lore

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Proteankin
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your blood bubbles with the roiling quintessence of the plane of chaos, the infinite sea of primal chaos that long ago spawned the other Outer Planes.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your blood bubbles with the roiling quintessence of the plane of chaos, the infinite sea of primal chaos that long ago spawned the other Outer Planes. You gain resistance to a single damage type equal to half your level; at the beginning of each day, determine randomly whether this resistance applies to acid, electricity, or sonic damage. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would cause you to gain the controlled condition.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Proteankin

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Reinforced Chassis
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your body is designed to be particularly resilient.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Your body is designed to be particularly resilient. Your chassis is made from reinforced armor plating that grants a +3 item bonus to AC with a Dexterity cap of +1. If you are at least 5th level, the item bonus increases to +4 and at 10th level it increases to +5. You can never wear other armor or remove your chassis; however, you still don't become fatigued from sleeping. You can etch armor runes onto your chassis. Your chassis is medium armor in the plate group for abilities and for etching runes.

**Enhancement** Your chassis becomes difficult to overcome. You gain the Chassis Deflection reaction.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Reinforced Chassis

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Sea Legs
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.prerequisites: You don't have a swim Speed.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You are comfortable on the water for short bursts.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You are comfortable on the water for short bursts. You gain a swim Speed of 10 feet and can breathe underwater for 5 minutes.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Sea Legs

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Seasong
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Sound carries far beneath the waves, and your people have strong, enchanting voices.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Sound carries far beneath the waves, and your people have strong, enchanting voices. You become trained in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, you gain the Virtuosic Performer skill feat for singing, and your voice carries equally well above and below water.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Seasong

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Sequestered Spell
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You consumed so much of a type of magic as a larva that you can now cast it purely on instinct.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You consumed so much of a type of magic as a larva that you can now cast it purely on instinct. Choose one cantrip from the spell list of your magiphage ability. You can cast this cantrip as an innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Sequestered Spell

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Skilled Herbalist
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've been taught how to craft healing remedies with a variety of herbs and plants.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've been taught how to craft healing remedies with a variety of herbs and plants. You gain the Alchemical Crafting feat, except you must select the following items to add to your formula book: Antidote (Lesser), Antiplague (Lesser), and Elixir of Life (Minor), as well as a fourth 1st-level common alchemical formula of your choice. You can use Nature to Craft an alchemical item that has the healing trait, rather than Crafting.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Skilled Herbalist

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Small Speak
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You understand the languages of most small insects and can speak to them.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You understand the languages of most small insects and can speak to them. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with insects, arthropods, and terrestrial invertebrates. The GM determines which creatures count for this ability.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Small Speak

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Steelhoof
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've girded your hooves in steel or other reinforcements aimed to inflict maximum damage.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've girded your hooves in steel or other reinforcements aimed to inflict maximum damage. Your hoof attack deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage instead of 1d6.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Steelhoof

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Sublime Mobility
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your heritage has granted you either impressive athletic skill or a physical feature that aids in traversal.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your heritage has granted you either impressive athletic skill or a physical feature that aids in traversal. You gain either a climb Speed or a swim Speed of 10 feet.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Sublime Mobility

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Surki Lore
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Either through the tales of elders in your settlement or through the messages thumped by those who oversaw your generation dig, you hold the knowledge of many surkis before you.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Either through the tales of elders in your settlement or through the messages thumped by those who oversaw your generation dig, you hold the knowledge of many surkis before you. You become trained in Survival and the skill associated with the magical tradition from your magiphage ability (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, or Religion for divine). If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Surki Lore.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Surki Lore

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Surki Weapon Familiarity
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Surki weapons favor utility and practicality over grace and brutality.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Surki weapons favor utility and practicality over grace and brutality. You have familiarity with picks, light hammers, sickles, scythes, and one additional common weapon of your choice from the axe or hammer group—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Surki Weapon Familiarity

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Swimmer's Guidance
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You're always ready to help those floundering in the water.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You're always ready to help those floundering in the water. Any ally who starts their turn within 30 feet of you and in the same body of water gains a 10-foot swim Speed until the end of their turn. If any ally affected by Swimmer's Guidance rolls a critical failure on an Athletics check to Swim, they get a failure instead.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Swimmer's Guidance

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Take Flight
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Though it's not fully effective, much of your ability to fly has stayed with you.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per round

Though it's not fully effective, much of your ability to fly has stayed with you. You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet for this movement. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Take Flight

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Tooth and Claw
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've become adept with your born weapons.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've become adept with your born weapons. Choose a second animal attack appropriate to your animal type and heritage.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Tooth and Claw

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Undead Hunter
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You gain Vitality Lash as an innate divine cantrip.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You gain Vitality Lash as an innate divine cantrip.

**Enhancement** You can infuse your attacks with vitality. You can cast Infuse Vitality as a 3rd-rank arcane innate spell once per day, targeting only yourself.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Undead Hunter

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Vestigial Magicsense
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: While most surkis' ability to taste magic fades once they metamorphose into their adult form—replaced by keener darkvision—you've retained some of this sense.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: While most surkis' ability to taste magic fades once they metamorphose into their adult form—replaced by keener darkvision—you've retained some of this sense. You gain magicsense as a vague sense that has a range of 30 feet—like all vague senses, it's only about as precise as an average human's sense of smell, meaning you generally can predict only if magic is present; however, each tradition of magic has a unique taste to you, allowing you to identify the tradition of magic present.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Vestigial Magicsense

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Warped Reflection
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.traits: concentrate, emotion, fear, mental, reflection, visual
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Due to your origins, your form is more flexible than most.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per minute

Due to your origins, your form is more flexible than most. You shift your appearance to resemble a creature within 30 feet but with an unsettling, horrifying twist. Though this transformation is momentary, witnessing it gives the target deep existential dread. It must succeed at a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure) and be Stupefied 1 as long as the frightened condition lasts. Once you've used Warped Reflection against a creature, it's temporarily immune for 24 hours.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Warped Reflection

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Wave Speaker
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Being part fish yourself, you can speak the language of the sea.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Being part fish yourself, you can speak the language of the sea. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals that have the amphibious trait, aquatic trait, or a swim Speed, such as fish, crabs, and some seabirds (like penguins). The GM determines which animals count for this ability.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Wave Speaker

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: You're So Cute!
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You know how to put on the charm, doing playful tricks to win favor.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You know how to put on the charm, doing playful tricks to win favor. You are trained in Performance and gain the Impressive Performance feat. When performing for humanoids, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Make an Impression with Performance.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: You're So Cute!

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Accommodating Mount
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've trained to serve as a mount, if only for your most trusted allies.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've trained to serve as a mount, if only for your most trusted allies. When another PC rides you as a mount, your expert coordination allows them to gain three actions at the start of their turn, rather than the two they normally would for riding another PC. You still gain only two actions at the start of your turn, instead of three, as you spend one action keeping them balanced on your back and ensuring they're firmly mounted.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Accommodating Mount

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Alarming Disappearance
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your ability to move unseen is startling for one your size, causing panic among your enemies.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your ability to move unseen is startling for one your size, causing panic among your enemies. When you successfully Hide when previously observed, creatures you are hidden from become Frightened 1. They are then temporarily immune to Alarming Disappearance for 1 hour. Typically, creatures that have traveled with you for a significant time, such as your fellow party members, are immune to your Alarming Disappearance.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Alarming Disappearance

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Amorphous Aspect
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your body is supremely flexible.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your body is supremely flexible. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on checks to Escape or Squeeze, and when you critically fail when Squeezing, you get a failure instead.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Amorphous Aspect

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Apprentice Sea Witch
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You're familiar with the basic spells that most educated merfolk know.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You're familiar with the basic spells that most educated merfolk know. Once per day, you can cast either Create Water or Hydraulic Push as a 1st-rank primal innate spell. Each time you cast *create water*, you choose if you create fresh water or salt water.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Apprentice Sea Witch

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Arcane Safeguards
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: The magic powering you makes it difficult for outside magic to affect you.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
The magic powering you makes it difficult for outside magic to affect you. You gain the Resist Magic reaction.

**Enhancement** Your safeguards improve. When you Resist Magic, you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to the spell rank of the triggering effect.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Arcane Safeguards

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Beast of Burden
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your broad frame can allow you to carry weights that immobilize smaller creatures.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your broad frame can allow you to carry weights that immobilize smaller creatures. Increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 4. You can rest normally while wearing medium armor.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Beast of Burden

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Bestial Brutality
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your animalistic unarmed attack grows more dangerous.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your animalistic unarmed attack grows more dangerous. The unarmed attack you chose for Bestial Manifestation gains the deadly d6 trait. Whenever you score a critical hit with this unarmed attack, you get the brawling critical specialization effect.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Bestial Brutality

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Blast Resistance
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You're used to the clamor of steel, the crack of a firearm, and the thunderous blast of explosions.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You're used to the clamor of steel, the crack of a firearm, and the thunderous blast of explosions. You gain resistance 3 to fire and sonic. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an effect that causes the dazzled or deafened conditions, you get a critical success instead.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Blast Resistance

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Call the First Tools
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can call upon the ancient powers bestowed on you by the gods to create any tools you might need at a moment's notice.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You can call upon the ancient powers bestowed on you by the gods to create any tools you might need at a moment's notice. You conjure forth a simple tool, such as a shovel or hammer, into your hands. This tool remains conjured until your next daily preparations so long as it's on your person. If the tool leaves your possession for more than 1 minute, it falls apart into a pile of silk that then dissolves into nothingness.

At 9th level, you can use this ability once per hour instead of once per day. When using it in this way, you can maintain only one tool at a time; any previous tool you conjured dissolves into nothingness.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Call the First Tools

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Call to Battle
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You channel the undying spirit of the einherjar to join to fight.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Trigger** You lose the unconscious condition.

You channel the undying spirit of the einherjar to join to fight. You Stand. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Call to Battle

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Chemical Trail
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can leave a faint chemical trail as you move and can use the chemical trails of other surkis to navigate.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You can leave a faint chemical trail as you move and can use the chemical trails of other surkis to navigate. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all checks and saves to Sense Direction or reorient yourself.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Chemical Trail

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Coral Growth
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: The difference between yourself and your coral symbiotes is nearly impossible to tell apart as your bodies are so intertwined.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: The difference between yourself and your coral symbiotes is nearly impossible to tell apart as your bodies are so intertwined. When you are underwater, you no longer need to eat or drink, as your coral symbiotes provide you with sufficient nutrition. While you are on land, your body provides your coral symbiotes with sufficient hydration. You no longer need to submerge yourself in water every 24 hours.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Coral Growth

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Distant Archer
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've trained to harry your foes from great distances, using your swiftness to maintain distance and keen eyesight to stay on target.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've trained to harry your foes from great distances, using your swiftness to maintain distance and keen eyesight to stay on target. You reduce the penalty for attacking beyond your first range increment by 1, to a minimum of 0, when using weapons in the bow weapon group.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Distant Archer

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Extraplanar Haze
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your body emits tiny particles of extraplanar matter, such as crystalline motes or smoky vapor, that surround you in a haze.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

Your body emits tiny particles of extraplanar matter, such as crystalline motes or smoky vapor, that surround you in a haze. You become concealed, though you can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak, as normal for concealment where your position is still obvious. These particles stay within an inch of your skin, move with you, and last for a number of rounds equal to half your level.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Extraplanar Haze

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Fierce Grasp
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Once you get your hands on someone, it's hard for them to get away.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Requirements** You have an opponent grabbed or restrained.

Once you get your hands on someone, it's hard for them to get away. Your opponent takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their next attempt to Escape from being grabbed or restrained by you, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your AC against any attacks they make against you while you have them grabbed.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Fierce Grasp

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Fishblooded
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: There's nothing beneath the waves that can slow you down.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: There's nothing beneath the waves that can slow you down. When in an aquatic environment, you ignore difficult terrain. In addition, swimming up or down isn't difficult terrain for you.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Fishblooded

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Growing Eel Friend
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your eel pet grows larger and stronger.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your eel pet grows larger and stronger. Your eel pet's size changes to Small, and the eel gains the Scent and Tough pet abilities. However, it becomes too large to carry in a water-filled globe.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Growing Eel Friend

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Hardened Chassis
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your exterior is so tough that only the strongest of weapons can fully damage it.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Your exterior is so tough that only the strongest of weapons can fully damage it. Choose one type of damage among bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. You gain resistance 3 to that type of damage. This resistance does not apply if the weapon or attack is adamantine.

**Enhancement** Your chassis gets even tougher. Choose one of the following benefits: you gain resistance 3 to all physical damage, or your chosen resistance increases to a value equal to half your level (minimum 3). This resistance is still bypassed by adamantine.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Hardened Chassis

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Healing Flesh
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Some legends claim that the flesh of a merfolk, if consumed, can grant health, longevity, and even immortality.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Some legends claim that the flesh of a merfolk, if consumed, can grant health, longevity, and even immortality. For obvious reasons, merfolk prefer to discourage these rumors (with violence, if necessary), but you're living proof that there's at least a fraction of truth to such claims. When Administering First Aid, Treating Disease, or Treating Wounds, you can take 1 damage to give someone a drop of your blood. When you do so, you don't need healer's tools, and you gain a +1 item bonus to your Medicine check.

If someone were to eat your heart and liver within an hour of your death, they would be healed of all physical injuries (regaining Hit Points up to their maximum) and would cease to age for 8 years.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Healing Flesh

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Infiltration Automaton
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You have quiet, well-oiled joints, and you move around as silently as a shadow, though you sometimes use a magical boost.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You have quiet, well-oiled joints, and you move around as silently as a shadow, though you sometimes use a magical boost. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks against hearing-based Perception checks. You can cast Silence once per day on yourself as a 2nd-rank arcane innate spell.

**Enhancement** You can cast silence twice per day on yourself, and you can choose whether to cast it as a 2nd- or 4th-rank spell.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Infiltration Automaton

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Inscribed Blast
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Some of the patterning on your exterior covering is not just decorative but is instead a set of runes.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Trigger** A creature or object adjacent to you damages you.

**Requirements** Your inscribed runes are currently intact.

Some of the patterning on your exterior covering is not just decorative but is instead a set of runes. The triggering creature or object takes level-based force damage and your inscribed runes fade. You re-inscribe your runes each day during your daily preparations. At 10th level and every 5 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4.

**Enhancement** You can re-inscribe your runes with 10 minutes of work as an exploration activity.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Inscribed Blast

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Integrated Armament
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your mechanical body houses a weapon or shield that you can quickly draw and stow, leaving you prepared for combat at all times.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Your mechanical body houses a weapon or shield that you can quickly draw and stow, leaving you prepared for combat at all times.

You can use a 1-minute activity, which has the manipulate trait, to integrate a single, one-handed weapon or shield into one of your arms. You can draw or stow this item as an Interact action. Creatures don't automatically see this integrated item when it's stowed and must actively Seek in order to find it. They take a –2 circumstance penalty to any checks to do so. While you are wielding the item, it can't be Disarmed and you can't drop or Release it; you must Interact to store the weapon and free that hand. A creature determined to retrieve the item can do so, but it requires either 1 minute to remove it or extreme violence to your arm—such as physically removing portions of the limb. You can only have one integrated armament at a time, though you can use the 1-minute activity to replace the item or swap the arm in which it's stored.

**Enhancement** Your body has more space for integration. You can now either integrate two one-handed weapons, a one-handed weapon and a shield, or a single two-handed weapon which is split across both arms. You can use a single Interact action to draw or store both integrated armaments. When you draw a single weapon, you can choose to hold it with either one hand or both hands.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Integrated Armament

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Jotun's Battle Stance
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You emulate the battle stance of your forebears, allowing you to use mighty weapons to attack distant foes.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You emulate the battle stance of your forebears, allowing you to use mighty weapons to attack distant foes. While in this stance, when you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, the weapon gains a reach of 10 feet.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Jotun's Battle Stance

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Jotun's Grasp
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've mastered a technique that allows you to close the gap on foes and wrestle them into submission.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've mastered a technique that allows you to close the gap on foes and wrestle them into submission. You Step and attempt an Athletics check to Grapple a creature.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Jotun's Grasp

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Labyrinthine Echoes
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can make your voice reverberate off any surface.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You can make your voice reverberate off any surface. Once per day, you can cast Ventriloquism as an occult innate spell. At 7th level, this spell is heightened to 2nd rank.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Labyrinthine Echoes

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Late Awakener
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Whether due to a more gradual process or your animal and sapient sides being especially in conflict, your awakening was a little slower than most, but your eyes are now fully open and your abilities…
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Whether due to a more gradual process or your animal and sapient sides being especially in conflict, your awakening was a little slower than most, but your eyes are now fully open and your abilities have returned. You gain all the mechanical benefits of the awakened animal heritage you selected at 1st level, allowing you to take feats and gain any benefits that require a specific awakened animal heritage.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Late Awakener

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Magical Resistance
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your animating magic provides some defense.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Your animating magic provides some defense. Choose one of the following energy damage types: cold, electricity, or sonic. You gain resistance 5 to that damage type.

**Enhancement** You tap deeper into your animating magic, and your resistances improve. Choose one of the following benefits: you gain resistance 5 to the remaining two damage types from the above list, or your chosen resistance increases to a value equal to 1 + half your level.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Magical Resistance

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Mistaken Identity
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You feel a strong connection with your progenitor and can convince yourself an effect targeting your mind was meant for theirs instead, allowing you to shrug off harmful effects.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per minute

**Trigger** You're about to attempt a saving throw against a mental effect.

You feel a strong connection with your progenitor and can convince yourself an effect targeting your mind was meant for theirs instead, allowing you to shrug off harmful effects. Roll the saving throw twice, and take the higher result. However, subsuming your identity is disturbing, and you're Frightened 1.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Mistaken Identity

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Natural Ambassador
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You remember what it was like to speak easily with other animals, using old, familiar ways of communication to learn what they want and ask for favors in return.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You remember what it was like to speak easily with other animals, using old, familiar ways of communication to learn what they want and ask for favors in return. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with all animals, not just those of your kind. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy when you do, or a +2 circumstance bonus with animals of your kind.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Natural Ambassador

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Natural Orienteering
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: There are few twisting paths that can disorient you.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: There are few twisting paths that can disorient you. When you roll a success on a Survival check to Sense Direction or Track, you get a critical success instead.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Natural Orienteering

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Noxious Odor
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You have developed your skill with your defensive pheromones and have concentrated them into a noxious form.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You have developed your skill with your defensive pheromones and have concentrated them into a noxious form. A creature that fails its save against your Emit Defensive Odor action also becomes Sickened 1 (or Sickened 2 on a critical failure).
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Noxious Odor

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Planar Resilience
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your body has adapted to the variety of harsh climes that you encounter in your travels.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Your body has adapted to the variety of harsh climes that you encounter in your travels. You treat temperature-based environmental effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold or heat becomes extreme, extreme cold or heat becomes severe, and so on).

Additionally, the planar energies that move through you allow you to further adapt your body with some concentration and effort. During your daily preparations, choose either cold or fire. You gain resistance to that damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Planar Resilience

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Pounding Leap
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You use the momentum of your massive fists to launch yourself through the air.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You use the momentum of your massive fists to launch yourself through the air. Strike with your fist unarmed attack and then attempt a High Jump or Long Jump; you count as having a running start and do not need to Stride before this activity to avoid failure. You can attempt this Strike against an unattended object or unoccupied flat surface, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Athletics check to High Jump or Long Jump when you do so.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Pounding Leap

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Proud Mentor
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You enjoy mentoring others and take pride in your students' accomplishments.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You enjoy mentoring others and take pride in your students' accomplishments. If you get a critical failure on an attempt to Aid, you get a failure instead. Whenever you successfully Aid an ally who critically succeeds on the check you Aided them on, you feel a rush of pride, gaining temporary Hit Points equal to your level, which last for 1 minute.

Effect: Proud Mentor
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Proud Mentor

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Puzzle Solver
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You have a natural affinity for problem-solving and the unknown.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You have a natural affinity for problem-solving and the unknown. Whenever you attempt to Recall Knowledge about a subject or creature, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next skill check regarding that creature or subject (even if you didn't succeed at the check). This bonus increases to +2 if you are a master in the skill used to Recall Knowledge.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Puzzle Solver

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Reflective Pocket
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've formed a connection with a small hand mirror, allowing you to use it as an extradimensional storage space.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've formed a connection with a small hand mirror, allowing you to use it as an extradimensional storage space. You can store one item of light Bulk in your mirror at a time. Storing or retrieving an item requires an Interact action and any creature can do so. While an item is stored within the mirror, the mirror reflects the item's image. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to Conceal the Object unless someone checks the mirror's reflection.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Reflective Pocket

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Replicate
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've learned to reshape your malleable form.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've learned to reshape your malleable form. You can cast Illusory Disguise once per day as an innate occult spell. This is a morph effect, as your body physically transforms, rather than an illusion effect.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Replicate

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Resilient Chassis
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You are tough enough to draw on your own internal stores of energy when you get injured.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You would take damage.

You are tough enough to draw on your own internal stores of energy when you get injured. You gain 4 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 round. At 8th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the temporary Hit Points increase by 4.

**Enhancement** Resilient Chassis's frequency becomes once per 10 minutes.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Resilient Chassis

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Resilient Physiology
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your ordered physiology rejects unwelcome elements, allowing you to reject the negative effects of poisons and diseases or shrug off other lasting negative effects.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You're afflicted by a disease or poison, or are taking persistent damage.

Your ordered physiology rejects unwelcome elements, allowing you to reject the negative effects of poisons and diseases or shrug off other lasting negative effects. Choose one.

**Disease or Poison** Attempt a saving throw against the affliction. On a failure or critical failure, the affliction's stage doesn't increase.

**Persistent Damage** Attempt a DC 10 flat to recover from the persistent damage.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Resilient Physiology

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Riptide Mount
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: After working with aquatic beasts of burden for years, you have learned how to easily mount and dismount them.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Requirements** You are underwater and adjacent to a creature that is at least one size larger than you, has a swim Speed, and is willing to be your mount.

After working with aquatic beasts of burden for years, you have learned how to easily mount and dismount them. You Mount the creature and Command an Animal to issue it an order of your choice.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Riptide Mount

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Scurry!
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your instincts to move to safety are strong.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Trigger** You roll initiative.

Your instincts to move to safety are strong. You Stride; you must end your movement in a location where you have cover from at least one enemy you can see, and you can't take this action if it's impossible for you to do so. You can Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Scurry!

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Secondary Adaptation
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've continued to adapt to the rigors of your environment by continuing your metamorphosis, even as an adult.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've continued to adapt to the rigors of your environment by continuing your metamorphosis, even as an adult. Choose one surki heritage that you don't already have; you gain that heritage and its benefits.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Secondary Adaptation

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Skilled Swimmer
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You move through the water with ease, mastering your movements with years of practice.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You move through the water with ease, mastering your movements with years of practice. When in an aquatic environment, you ignore difficult terrain. In addition, swimming up or down isn't difficult terrain for you.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Skilled Swimmer

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Spark Fist
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You dust explosive black powder on your fist or glove before attacking, which combusts as you hit an opponent.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per minute

You dust explosive black powder on your fist or glove before attacking, which combusts as you hit an opponent. The resulting pops of flame harm both you and your enemy. Until the end of your next turn, your fist loses the nonlethal trait and deals an additional 1 fire damage on a successful Strike. Each time you succeed on a fist Strike, you take 1 fire damage. If your fist would deal more than one weapon damage die, the fire damage dealt on a successful Strike, to both you and your opponent, is equal to the number of weapon damage dice.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Spark Fist

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Speaker in Training
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.prerequisites: budding speaker centaur heritage or the ability to cast a divine or primal spell
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've begun your training as a Speaker.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've begun your training as a Speaker. Select divine or primal. If you selected divine, you're a Faithspeaker. If you selected primal, you're a Greenspeaker. If you've already made this decision (such as due to being a budding speaker) you must select the same Speaker you previously chose. This choice can't be changed. If you're a Faithspeaker, you can cast Bless once per day as a divine innate spell; if you're a Greenspeaker, you can cast Fleet Step once per day as a primal innate spell.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Speaker in Training

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Stretching Reach
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can leverage your size and muscle to extend your reach and attack more distant foes.
