pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You can leverage your size and muscle to extend your reach and attack more distant foes. While in this stance, when you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, the weapon gains a reach of 10 feet.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Stretching Reach

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Strong of Wing
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can fly with a greater distance.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You can fly with a greater distance. The fly Speed you gain from Take Flight increases to 25 feet.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Strong of Wing

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Strong Tail
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: From sheer necessity, you've gotten surprisingly good at moving around on land.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: From sheer necessity, you've gotten surprisingly good at moving around on land. Your tail is unusually muscular and lets you hop or slither on land at a modest speed. Your land Speed increases to 15 feet.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Strong Tail

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Towering Presence
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You fill an area with your force of will, towering beyond where your true form should be.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You fill an area with your force of will, towering beyond where your true form should be. Increase your size to Large until the beginning of your next turn. Your equipment grows with you but returns to natural size if removed. You're Clumsy 1. Your reach increases by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if you started out Tiny), and you gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage. Towering Presence has no effect if you were already Large or larger.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Towering Presence

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Tunnel Roll
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can more easily navigate underground tunnels by rolling up into a ball.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You can more easily navigate underground tunnels by rolling up into a ball. You roll up and move up to four times your Speed in a straight line down an incline. If you reach the bottom of the incline or hit an obstacle during this first turn of movement, you stop rolling. Otherwise, you automatically keep rolling at this Speed during subsequent turns until you hit the bottom of the incline or an obstacle ends this movement (which can happen in the middle of your turn). You're Slowed 2 each turn after the first that you keep rolling; if you hit an obstacle on a turn after the first, you and the obstacle both take 4d6 bludgeoning damage, and you stop rolling.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Tunnel Roll

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Urban Jungle
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.prerequisites: Fascinated by Society; expert in Society or Survival
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Cities are just a new form of wilderness.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Cities are just a new form of wilderness. You've adapted to this wilderness and now can navigate it as easily as where you once came from. When in an urban area, you can move at your full Speed while you Track and you can use your choice of Survival or Society to Track.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Urban Jungle

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Warp Likeness
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You channel some of your own nature through your blow, temporarily warping your target's form to resemble your own.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per minute

**Requirements** You hit a creature with a melee Strike on your last action.

You channel some of your own nature through your blow, temporarily warping your target's form to resemble your own. The creature you hit must attempt a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target resists the effect but its form twists in the process. It's Clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.

**Failure** The target's body briefly warps to resemble yours. It's clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn and Sickened 1.

**Critical Failure** The target's body warps to resemble yours for a significant time. It's clumsy 1 for 1 minute and Sickened 2.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Warp Likeness

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Wild Stride
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can move quickly when using your preferred modes of travel.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Requirements** You have a free hand.

You can move quickly when using your preferred modes of travel. Stride twice. You gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed for these Strides, or a +10-foot circumstance bonus if you have two hands free.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Wild Stride

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Anarchic Arcana
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: The magic in your blood is unpredictable.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
The magic in your blood is unpredictable. When you make your daily preparations, roll 1d12 twice and consult the following list:

| 1 | Acid Grip |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | Blur |
| 3 | Gecko Grip |
| 4 | Humanoid Form |
| 5 | Illusory Object |
| 6 | Laughing Fit |
| 7 | Noise Blast |
| 8 | Resist Energy |
| 9 | See the Unseen |
| 10 | Shatter |
| 11 | Shrink |
| 12 | Telekinetic Maneuver |

You can cast each of those two spells once during the following day (or one spell twice if you rolled the same number) as 2nd-rank divine innate spells
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Anarchic Arcana

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Animal Summoner
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: The connection between you and primal magic deepens.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: The connection between you and primal magic deepens. You can cast Summon Animal as a primal innate spell once per day, heightened to half your level rounded up.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Animal Summoner

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Arcane Camouflage
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You have developed magical techniques to aid you with stalking your prey.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You have developed magical techniques to aid you with stalking your prey. You can cast Blur and Invisibility each once per day as 2nd-rank arcane innate spells.

**Enhancement** Your camouflage is more potent. Your blur spell now lasts 10 minutes and when you cast invisibility, you can choose to gain the effects of the 4th-rank version of the spell. In addition, you can now cast blur and invisibility each twice per day.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Arcane Camouflage

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Arcane Propulsion
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You redirect energy from your core to ports on your back or feet, allowing you to fly for a short time.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You redirect energy from your core to ports on your back or feet, allowing you to fly for a short time. You can maintain this redirected energy for 5 minutes. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed while redirecting the energy.

**Enhancement** You can maintain your flight for longer. You can redirect your energy at all times, allowing you to fly whenever you want, rather than just once per day for 5 minutes.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Arcane Propulsion

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Arcane Slam
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You channel magical power from your core into your arm, empowering your attack as you attempt to slam your foe into the ground.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Requirements** You have a creature grabbed or restrained.

You channel magical power from your core into your arm, empowering your attack as you attempt to slam your foe into the ground. Attempt an Athletics check against the foe's Fortitude DC. You take a –2 circumstance penalty to your check if the target is one size larger than you and a –4 circumstance penalty if it's larger than that. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check if the target is one size smaller than you and a +4 circumstance bonus if it's smaller than that.

**Critical Success** You slam the foe down and the magical energy overwhelms it. The creature is knocked prone, becomes dazzled for 1 round, and takes damage equal to 2d6 plus your Strength modifier. The foe is no longer grabbed or restrained by you.

**Success** You slam the foe down. The creature is knocked prone and takes damage equal to your Strength modifier. The foe is no longer grabbed or restrained by you.

**Failure** You are unable to slam the creature, but your hold on the creature remains.

**Critical Failure** The creature breaks free and is no longer grabbed or restrained by you.

**Enhancement** Your arms better channel your core's power. You no longer take penalties for attempting to slam larger foes. Your foe takes damage equal to 2d6 plus your Strength modifier on a success (or double that on a critical success).
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Arcane Slam

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Bodily Disintegration
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You have such complete control of your component atoms that you can momentarily separate them far enough apart for you to pass through solid material.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You have such complete control of your component atoms that you can momentarily separate them far enough apart for you to pass through solid material. You focus on your physical body and will the parts of it to disassemble momentarily. You Stride. You can pass through creatures and tiny cracks during this movement. You cannot pass through solid walls or magical boundaries such as a wall of force. If you haven't completely passed through a creature or object by the end of your movement, you take 4d6 bludgeoning damage and are shunted to the nearest spot that you can occupy.

**Enhancement** When you use Bodily Disintegration, you can move through solid walls and delay fully reassembling your body, causing you to become concealed until the start of your next turn.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Bodily Disintegration

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Build the First Walls
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: The powers of creation that run through you allow you to conjure a temporary wall.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

The powers of creation that run through you allow you to conjure a temporary wall. You create a wall of dirt with the effects of Wall of Stone with the following exceptions. The wall can be up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high and must stand vertically, preventing you from building other structures with it. Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 20 Hit Points. The wall remains for 1 hour or until Dismissed.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Build the First Walls

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Consume Magic
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You consume the magic of an incoming spell or effect to protect your allies, though you might give yourself indigestion.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You attempt a saving throw against an area effect from the tradition matching your magiphage ability.

You consume the magic of an incoming spell or effect to protect your allies, though you might give yourself indigestion. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect; your counteract rank equals half your level (rounded up), and for the roll, use either your class DC – 10 or your spellcasting attribute modifier plus your spellcasting proficiency bonus. If you counteract the triggering effect, you end the effect for all other creatures in the area, but you become Sickened 1 as your body struggles to absorb the influx of magic.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Consume Magic

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Coral Detoxification
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: The coral colony that you've tended has merged with your kidneys to add an additional layer of filtration.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

The coral colony that you've tended has merged with your kidneys to add an additional layer of filtration. Attempt a saving throw against a single poison affecting you with a +2 circumstance bonus.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Coral Detoxification

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Core Attunement
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your core allows you to draw more power from it.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Your core allows you to draw more power from it. Select one 1st-rank arcane spell and one 2nd-rank or lower arcane spell, to which you have access. You can cast your chosen spells as arcane innate spells each once per day.

**Enhancement** Your attunement grows stronger. Select one 5th-rank or lower arcane spell and one 6th-rank or lower arcane spell, to which you have access. You can cast them as arcane innate spells each once per day, in addition to the original spells.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Core Attunement

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Demolitionist
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You know how to destroy objects with a well-placed explosion.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You know how to destroy objects with a well-placed explosion. Whenever you hit with a bomb Strike against a trap or an unattended object, you ignore the first 5 points of the object's Hardness.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Demolitionist

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Emissary Assistance
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: As an emissary, you have assisted land-bound creatures in journeying underwater to visit your settlements.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: As an emissary, you have assisted land-bound creatures in journeying underwater to visit your settlements. You gain Feet to Fins and Water Breathing as 3rd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these spells once per day.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Emissary Assistance

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Extraplanar Cloud
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: When you use Extraplanar Haze, you can spend 1 additional action to disperse the particles as a 10-foot emanation cloud centered on you instead of as a haze; the activity gains the concentrate trait.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: When you use Extraplanar Haze, you can spend 1 additional action to disperse the particles as a 10-foot emanation cloud centered on you instead of as a haze; the activity gains the concentrate trait. All creatures within the cloud become concealed, and all creatures outside the cloud become concealed to creatures within it.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Extraplanar Cloud

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Fierce Competitor
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You challenge a single ally to a physical competition.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You challenge a single ally to a physical competition. This competition must involve accomplishing a specific goal for a specific use of the Acrobatics or Athletics skill, such as Climbing to the top of a wall, Tripping a specific foe, or Long Jumping across a chasm. You and your selected ally gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the associated skill check for 1 minute or until one of you wins the challenge, whichever is first. If you win this competition, you gain a +2 status bonus to Intimidation checks for 1 hour.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Fierce Competitor

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Friendly Fling
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can scoop up your friends with your horns to hurl them across the battlefield.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Requirements** You are adjacent to an ally.

You can scoop up your friends with your horns to hurl them across the battlefield. Pick up an adjacent willing ally who is smaller than you and toss them to an unoccupied space you can see within 20 feet. Since you are using your horns, you don't need to have any hands free to do this. Your ally's movement doesn't trigger reactions. Your ally ends this movement on their feet and doesn't take damage from the fall but takes 1d6 piercing damage from your horns. If your ally ends this movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against an enemy within their reach as a reaction.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Friendly Fling

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Full Flight
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your flight is unbound, as natural as it was before you were awakened.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your flight is unbound, as natural as it was before you were awakened. You have a fly Speed of 25 feet at all times.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Full Flight

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Glory and Valor!
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You call upon your ascendant blood with a mighty cry that fills you with a revitalizing energy for 1 minute or until you critically fail a Strike, whichever comes first.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You call upon your ascendant blood with a mighty cry that fills you with a revitalizing energy for 1 minute or until you critically fail a Strike, whichever comes first. For the duration, the first time each round you successfully Strike a creature of your level or higher, you regain Hit Points equal to half your level.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Glory and Valor!

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Goring Charge
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Driven by the momentum of your thundering steps and powerful mass, your horns can pierce your foes.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Driven by the momentum of your thundering steps and powerful mass, your horns can pierce your foes. Stride twice, then make a horns Strike. If you moved at least 20 feet from your starting position, your horns Strike also deals 1d6 persistent bleed damage.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Goring Charge

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Grand Metamorphosis
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: One of your nodes has adapted into a new magic-emitting organ.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
One of your nodes has adapted into a new magic-emitting organ. You gain one of the evolutions from your surki heritage. If you have multiple heritages, you choose one to evolve.

**Special** You can take this feat multiple times, gaining a new evolution each time. The evolution can be for a heritage you've already evolved or a different one.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Grand Metamorphosis

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Herbal Forager
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your skill with herbs has improved.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your skill with herbs has improved. Each day as part of your daily preparations, you can harvest ingredients from your surroundings to craft one temporary alchemical item you know the formula for. This alchemical item must have the healing trait. If not consumed by your next daily preparations, the item is rendered inert.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Herbal Forager

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Iivlar's Deflection
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You're able to use the silk woven into your skin to deflect attacks, reducing the deadliness of grievous blows.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Trigger** You are struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage.

You're able to use the silk woven into your skin to deflect attacks, reducing the deadliness of grievous blows. Attempt a DC 17 flat. If you are successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Iivlar's Deflection

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Ill Tide
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Some land dwellers say that merfolk are bad luck.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** A creature within 30 feet of you critically fails an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw

Some land dwellers say that merfolk are bad luck. You might not cause bad luck, but you can certainly keep it going. The next time the triggering creature attempts an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw, it must roll twice and use the worse result.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Ill Tide

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Jotun's Boost
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your giant might allows you to pick up your allies and hurl them across the battlefield.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Requirements** You have at least one hand free and are adjacent to an ally.

Your giant might allows you to pick up your allies and hurl them across the battlefield. Pick up an adjacent willing ally who is smaller than you and toss them to an unoccupied space you can see within 25 feet; if you have two hands free, you can instead toss them into a space within 30 feet. Your ally's movement doesn't trigger reactions. Your ally ends this movement on their feet and doesn't take damage from the fall. If your ally ends this movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against an enemy within their reach as a reaction.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Jotun's Boost

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Larcenous Tail
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can perform minor mischief with your tail.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You can perform minor mischief with your tail. You can use your tail to Steal an object, though your tail still can't hold onto it at the end of your action. If you have a hand free, you can transfer the stolen object to your hand. Otherwise, your tail surreptitiously drops it on the ground in your space, where you can grab it later. Observers other than your target who haven't witnessed you stealing something with your tail are usually distracted, meaning the GM will usually decrease their Perception DCs, as normal for Stealing something.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Larcenous Tail

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Lesser Augmentation
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You know how to get the most out of your unique body and abilities.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You know how to get the most out of your unique body and abilities. You gain the enhancement benefits of one of your 1st- or 5th-level automaton ancestry feats. You are also capable of reconfiguring your augmentations to meet your needs. You can spend one week of downtime to change the enhancement you gain with this feat.

**Enhancement** You gain the enhancement benefits of another 1st- or 5th-level automaton ancestry feat. Also, your reconfigurations take less time. You only need to spend 1 day of downtime to change any of your enhancements. If you have multiple enhancements, changing each one requires a separate day.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Lesser Augmentation

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Mentor of Legends
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You're an extraordinary teacher, capable of inspiring your students to amazing feats of athletics and ingenuity.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You're an extraordinary teacher, capable of inspiring your students to amazing feats of athletics and ingenuity. Once per day, you can cast Heroism as an innate divine spell; in addition to its normal effects, the spell also grants temporary Hit Points equal to half your level. You can't cast this spell on yourself.

Effect: Mentor of Legends
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Mentor of Legends

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Methodical Magic
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can reorder the world with your magic.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You can reorder the world with your magic. Choose two of the following spells: Calm, Dispel Magic, Lock, Mending, Shape Wood, or Translate. You can use each of the chosen spells once per day as 2nd-rank divine innate spells.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Methodical Magic

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Mirror Refuge
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your origin in the space behind mirrors enables you to use a mirror as a hideaway, like the spell One with Stone.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You're within 5 feet of a mirrored surface.

Your origin in the space behind mirrors enables you to use a mirror as a hideaway, like the spell One with Stone. You meld into an adjacent mirror. You can hear but not see outside this space, and creatures outside can't see or hear you. You can cast spells while within the mirror, but no effects can cross the mirror. Your Mirror Refuge lasts for 10 minutes unless the mirror is broken, which expels you and deals 10d6 damage to you. You can Dismiss the effect. You appear in a space adjacent to the mirror when the effect ends.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Mirror Refuge

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Moray Eel Mount
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You have either trained a giant moray eel since its hatching or have tamed one in the wild.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You have either trained a giant moray eel since its hatching or have tamed one in the wild. You gain the Bonded Animal skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites, to bond with a giant moray eel. When you Command this Animal while you are mounted on it to take a move action, you automatically succeed instead of needing to attempt a check.

**Special** If you have the Elver Pet or Growing Eel Friend ancestry feats, you can choose to have that pet become your bonded animal. You don't need to spend 7 days of downtime to bond with the eel, and you automatically succeed at the Nature check. You can then retrain those feats.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Moray Eel Mount

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Nodal Healing
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can induce wound repair by circulating magic throughout your body.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You can induce wound repair by circulating magic throughout your body. If you rest for 10 minutes, you regain Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier × half your level. This is a magical healing effect and is cumulative with any healing you receive from Treat Wounds.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Nodal Healing

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Overburn
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You engage your core, giving yourself more energy and speed for a fight.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You engage your core, giving yourself more energy and speed for a fight. You gain haste as an innate arcane 3rd-rank spell that you can cast once per day. You can target only yourself with this spell.

**Enhancement** You instead can cast haste as a 7th-rank innate arcane spell once per day. You must be one of the targets of the spell.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Overburn

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Persistent Odor
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your pheromones now linger on creatures.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your pheromones now linger on creatures. When a target fails its save against your Emit Defensive Odor ability, they also take level-based persistent poison damage. The damage increases to 2d6 at 13th level and 3d6 at 17th level.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Persistent Odor

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Plane Step
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You temporarily move just beyond the threshold of the current plane, granting you Concealment until the end of your next turn.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You temporarily move just beyond the threshold of the current plane, granting you Concealment until the end of your next turn. You remain clearly visible while stepping outside of a plane in this way and you can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Plane Step

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Rain of Bolts
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Throughout the day, your body produces powerful projectiles within your chassis.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

Throughout the day, your body produces powerful projectiles within your chassis. You fire them all at once in either a 30-foot cone or a 10-foot emanation. Foes in the area take level-based piercing damage with a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. This increases to 7d6 at 12th level, 8d6 at 15th level, and 9d6 at 18th level.

**Enhancement** The projectiles regenerate quicker, they are much more powerful, and you can refine the metallic content to harm certain creatures. You can use Rain of Bolts once per hour instead of once per day. The damage increases to 12d6 and each time you use the action, you can choose adamantine, cold iron, or silver. The damage from Rain of Bolts is treated as the metal you chose. At 20th level, the damage increases to 13d6.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Rain of Bolts

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Ride On
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Even when tired, you refuse to give up, pushing yourself to extreme feats of endurance.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You would gain the fatigued condition.

Even when tired, you refuse to give up, pushing yourself to extreme feats of endurance. You delay the effects of the fatigued condition for 3 rounds. If the fatigued condition has a duration, the duration begins to elapse only after the delay. You can't further delay or prevent the fatigued condition after this ability ends.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Ride On

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Shore Gift
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Using old magic, you slip off your tail like an item of clothing and walk on two feet, resembling a humanoid ancestry, usually human but possibly elf, half-elf, or something stranger.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Using old magic, you slip off your tail like an item of clothing and walk on two feet, resembling a humanoid ancestry, usually human but possibly elf, half-elf, or something stranger. You're still recognizably yourself, as the Shore Gift doesn't change your upper body. While transformed, you lose your swim Speed from your ancestry (though you might still have a swim Speed from other sources) but gain a land Speed of 25 feet.

Using the Shore Gift also counts as creating a disguise when using Deception to Impersonate, and your transformation automatically defeats Perception DCs to determine if you're a normal member of whatever ancestry you appear to be; only creatures actively rolling Perception to examine you might notice the disguise. You can remain in your alternate form indefinitely and can shift back to your merfolk form by using this action again.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Shore Gift

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Siphon Torment
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your progenitors suffered greatly at the hands of a curse, a fate you willingly take upon yourself rather than let fall upon others.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
Your progenitors suffered greatly at the hands of a curse, a fate you willingly take upon yourself rather than let fall upon others. Once per day, you can cast Claim Curse as an innate divine spell. When you do, the target creature gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level.

Effect: Siphon Torment
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Siphon Torment

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Siren Song
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can beguile and bewitch with your song.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You can beguile and bewitch with your song. All creatures in a 60-foot emanation must attempt a Will save against your Performance DC. On subsequent rounds, you can Sustain the song, causing each creature in the area currently affected by your song to attempt another Will save. Typically, creatures that have traveled with you for a significant time, such as your fellow party members, are immune to your Siren Song.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected and becomes immune to your Siren Song for 24 hours.

**Success** The target is fascinated with you until the end of your next turn.

**Failure** As success, and the target is Stupefied 1 for as long as it's fascinated.

**Critical Failure** As success, and the target is Stupefied 2 for as long as it's fascinated.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Siren Song

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Smoke Sight
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You're used to fighting and hiding in a haze of smoke and flame.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You're used to fighting and hiding in a haze of smoke and flame. You automatically succeed at the DC 5 flat to target a concealed creature if that creature is concealed only by smoke. When you are concealed or hidden in smoke, increase the DC of the flat check to target you to 6 if you're concealed or 12 if you're hidden.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Smoke Sight

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Speaker's Defense
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.prerequisites: budding speaker centaur heritage or Speaker in Training
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: As a Speaker, you've forged a deep bond with powerful spirits who you can urge to rise up to defend you and your people.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: As a Speaker, you've forged a deep bond with powerful spirits who you can urge to rise up to defend you and your people. If you're a Faithspeaker, you can call on gods or powerful planar beings to cast Share Life and Status, each once per day as innate divine spells; if you're a Greenspeaker, you can call on the forces of nature to cast Entangling Flora and Environmental Endurance, each once per day as innate primal spells.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Speaker's Defense

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Stone Passage
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Calling upon your knowledge of stonework and inherent magic, you momentarily make a section of stone insubstantial, allowing you to pass through.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

Calling upon your knowledge of stonework and inherent magic, you momentarily make a section of stone insubstantial, allowing you to pass through. Stride up to your Speed. You can move through stone or rock objects, such as walls, as if they were unoccupied spaces. If you end your movement inside a square that you normally would not be able to pass through, you are thrown back to the last unoccupied square you moved into.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Stone Passage

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Stubborn Defiance
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You're brave and stubborn and refuse to back down or bow to the wishes of another.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You're brave and stubborn and refuse to back down or bow to the wishes of another. You gain a +1 status bonus to saves against mental effects. Additionally, you gain the I Defy You! reaction.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Stubborn Defiance

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Tears of Pearl
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.traits: emotion, manipulate, mental, merfolk, primal, visual
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You weep, and your tears become gleaming pearls as they fall to the ground, so beautiful others can't help but grab at them.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You weep, and your tears become gleaming pearls as they fall to the ground, so beautiful others can't help but grab at them. All creatures adjacent to you must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The pearls dissolve at the start of your next turn, turning into salt water.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn as it covets the pearls or reaches for them.

**Failure** The target is slowed 1 until the start of your next turn as it grabs for the pearls, and if it doesn't have a free hand (or similar appendage), it must spend its first action on its next turn to Release one item it's holding.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is Slowed 2 instead of slowed 1.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Tears of Pearl

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Two Truths
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your ability to imitate your progenitor is so strong, you can even convince yourself.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your ability to imitate your progenitor is so strong, you can even convince yourself. When you use this action, you alter your thought processes to your progenitor or from your progenitor back to yourself. As long as what you say is true from the point of view of your current identity, you can say it even under effects like Ring of Truth that force you to speak truly.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Two Truths

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Unyielding Disguise
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.prerequisites: ability to cast humanoid form or illusory disguise
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: When you cast Humanoid Form or Illusory Disguise to alter your appearance, the spell's duration is 2 hours.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: When you cast Humanoid Form or Illusory Disguise to alter your appearance, the spell's duration is 2 hours. At the end of the duration, you can extend the spell's duration for another hour, but doing so is taxing, making you Drained 1. You can keep extending it in this way, increasing your drained condition by 1 each time, to a maximum duration of 6 hours.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Unyielding Disguise

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Alter Resistance
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You focus on your protean forebears to change your energy resistance.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You take acid, electricity, or sonic damage.

You focus on your protean forebears to change your energy resistance. The energy resistance you gain from your Proteankin lineage changes to match the triggering damage. This change occurs after the damage is dealt and lasts until the next day, or the next time you use this ability.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Alter Resistance

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Arcane Locomotion
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've modified your body to allow you to augment your movement.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You've modified your body to allow you to augment your movement. You gain either a climb Speed of 20 feet or a swim Speed of 20 feet, your choice.

**Enhancement** Your body allows for even further forms of movement. You can either select the option from this feat you haven't chosen yet (climb Speed or swim Speed), or you can increase your land Speed by 5 feet and increase the Speed you chose from this feat increase to be equal to your adjusted land Speed.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Arcane Locomotion

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Arise, Ye Worthy!
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: A touch of valkyrie magic in your blood lets you hold back death's grasp.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: A touch of valkyrie magic in your blood lets you hold back death's grasp. You can cast Breath of Life as a divine innate spell once per day.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Arise, Ye Worthy!

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Astral Blink
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've attuned your core to allow you to phase in and out of the Astral Plane, allowing you to teleport periodically.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You've attuned your core to allow you to phase in and out of the Astral Plane, allowing you to teleport periodically. You can cast Translocate once per hour as a 4th-rank innate arcane spell.

**Enhancement** Your attunement allows you to teleport in a series of quick jumps rather than in one big leap. You can expend your hourly use of translocate as a free action when you begin your turn. If you do, your Strides are augmented until the end of your turn, allowing you to instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Speed instead of traversing normally to the location. While augmented, your Strides gain the teleportation trait. Your augmented Strides don't trigger reactions that can be triggered by move actions or upon leaving or entering a square, unless those reactions trigger on teleportation.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Astral Blink

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Attuned Electroreceptors
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You grow specialized organs that allow you to detect even the faintest of heartbeats.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You grow specialized organs that allow you to detect even the faintest of heartbeats. You can sense living creatures and any creature with the electricity trait as an imprecise sense with a range of 20 feet. This range doubles while you are underwater, though only in the body of water you're in.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Attuned Electroreceptors

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Awaken Others
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can awaken others just through contact and communication.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You can awaken others just through contact and communication. You learn the Awaken Animal ritual. You use your own nature to supplement the ritual, so it costs 1/10 the value on the Creature Creation Rituals table instead of 1/5. If you would get a critical failure on the check, you instead get a failure.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Awaken Others

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Camouflage Coat
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've learned to use your natural camouflage to your advantage, enhancing your ability to blend with your surroundings through careful movements and additional markings or attire.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've learned to use your natural camouflage to your advantage, enhancing your ability to blend with your surroundings through careful movements and additional markings or attire. In your selected terrain, you can Hide or Sneak without cover or being concealed.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Camouflage Coat

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Coral Reserve
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your coral symbiotes provide a store of energy that you can call upon when needed.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You are enfeebled or fatigued.

Your coral symbiotes provide a store of energy that you can call upon when needed. You suppress your enfeebled or fatigued condition. (If you're affected by both, choose one to suppress.) After 1 minute, the condition returns with any remaining duration it had when you suppressed it.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Coral Reserve

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Core Rejuvenation
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your soul taps into your core's power to push against the grasp of death and allow you to recover consciousness.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You have the dying condition and are about to attempt a recovery check.

Your soul taps into your core's power to push against the grasp of death and allow you to recover consciousness. You're restored to 1 Hit Point, lose the dying and unconscious conditions, and can act normally on this turn. You gain or increase the wounded condition as normal when losing the dying condition in this way.

**Enhancement** Your soul can draw even more power from your core, granting you additional benefits. When you use Core Rejuvenation, you also gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to three times your level. These Hit Points remain for 1 minute.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Core Rejuvenation

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Crafter's Instinct
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You sense a minor flaw in the weapon as you fire it, and quickly adjust your aim on the fly to avoid the flaw.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You misfire with a firearm or you roll a failure on a Strike with a ranged weapon.

You sense a minor flaw in the weapon as you fire it, and quickly adjust your aim on the fly to avoid the flaw. If the triggering Strike was a misfire, you get a normal failure instead. If the triggering Strike was a failure, it becomes a glancing blow that deals minimum damage for the Strike (adding any bonuses as normal but getting a result of 1 for all damage dice that would be rolled on a success). The glancing blow does not apply other effects that would normally happen only on a hit.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Crafter's Instinct

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Digger
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.prerequisites: running animal or climbing animal heritage
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You are used to building homes and defenses underground.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You are used to building homes and defenses underground. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Digger

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Enlarged Chassis
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've empowered your core to support a larger body, granting you size and additional reach.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You've empowered your core to support a larger body, granting you size and additional reach. You gain the effects of enlarge constantly.

**Enhancement** Your core's empowerment has stabilized, allowing for greater support. You are no longer clumsy due to the effects of enlarge.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Enlarged Chassis

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Explosive Expert
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Through your extensive training with volatile weapons, you've built up a fair bit of tolerance to your own black powder explosions.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Through your extensive training with volatile weapons, you've built up a fair bit of tolerance to your own black powder explosions. You are immune to splash damage caused by your own Strikes with bombs and firearms (such as the splash damage from the scatter trait).
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Explosive Expert

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Generation Digger
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You're so adept at burrowing through the earth that you don't even need tools; in fact, you just might be trusted to lead the latest generation dig.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You're so adept at burrowing through the earth that you don't even need tools; in fact, you just might be trusted to lead the latest generation dig. You gain a burrow speed of 15 feet.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Generation Digger

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Iivlar's Boundary Break
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can bend the boundary between planes with the natural skill of an iivlar.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You can bend the boundary between planes with the natural skill of an iivlar. You can cast Flicker as a 4th-rank occult innate spell once per day. When you Sustain the spell, increase the distance you teleport to 15 feet.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Iivlar's Boundary Break

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Impose Order
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You shift the underlying fabric of reality to impose a baseline of order.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You would critically fail a skill check or suffer an effect with the misfortune trait.

You shift the underlying fabric of reality to impose a baseline of order. If the trigger was a skill check, you instead receive a result of 10 + your proficiency bonus (don't apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers). If the trigger was an effect with the misfortune trait, the misfortune and fortune effects cancel each other out as normal, negating the triggering misfortune effect.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Impose Order

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Incredible Sprint
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You push yourself, unleashing a burst of sudden speed.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You push yourself, unleashing a burst of sudden speed. You Stride three times.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Incredible Sprint

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Jotun's Restoration
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've mastered how to tap into your restorative powers at a higher frequency.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've mastered how to tap into your restorative powers at a higher frequency. You can use Caretaker's Restoration once per hour instead of once per day.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Jotun's Restoration

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Magitaxis
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You move reflexively toward the source of magic you most consumed as a larva.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Trigger** A creature you could reach with a Stride action Casts a Spell from the tradition matching your magiphage ability.

You move reflexively toward the source of magic you most consumed as a larva. You Stride, and you must end your movement adjacent to the triggering creature. You then can't use Magitaxis against the triggering creature for 24 hours as your reflexes reacclimate, though you can use it against other creatures.

You can use Magitaxis while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding (changing the trigger accordingly) if you have the corresponding movement type.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Magitaxis

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Malleable Form
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.prerequisites: ability to cast at least one polymorph spell
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You adroitly shift your form, taking on another appearance.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Requirements** You're polymorphed by a spell that has multiple choices of battle form.

You adroitly shift your form, taking on another appearance. Choose a different battle form of the polymorph spell affecting you, and change to that form instead of the current one. This destabilizes the spell's magic, reducing its duration by 1 round. Use the rank of the spell to determine the statistics, as normal.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Malleable Form

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Miraculous Medic
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your ability to heal others is miraculous enough to bring people back from near-death.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your ability to heal others is miraculous enough to bring people back from near-death. Once per day, you can cast Breath of Life as an innate primal spell.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Miraculous Medic

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Phantom Charm
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can harness the spiritual connection in your blood, allowing you to shift the negative threads of fate.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You attempt a check that would be subject to a misfortune effect.

You can harness the spiritual connection in your blood, allowing you to shift the negative threads of fate. You negate the misfortune effect and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering check.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Phantom Charm

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Plane Hop
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: The spaces between planes are obvious to you, and you can use them to move in unexpected ways.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

The spaces between planes are obvious to you, and you can use them to move in unexpected ways. You instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Speed.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Plane Hop

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Pummeling Whirlpool
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You draw water from the environs, swirling it into a rough torrent around you to punish your foes.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You draw water from the environs, swirling it into a rough torrent around you to punish your foes. Each creature in a 10-foot emanation (or 15 feet if you're in a body of water) takes 8d6 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature that fails its save is knocked prone. At 17th level, the damage increases to 11d6.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Pummeling Whirlpool

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Purge System
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You can sense the influence of harmful toxins in your body, and you heat and cool various parts of your body to expel them.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You can sense the influence of harmful toxins in your body, and you heat and cool various parts of your body to expel them. Choose one poison that is affecting you. Reduce the stage of that poison by one.

**Enhancement** When you use Purge System, you instead reduce the stage of the poison by two.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Purge System

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Rapid Pheromone Recovery
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your supply of pheromones replenish very quickly.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your supply of pheromones replenish very quickly. You can Emit Defensive Odor once per hour, rather than once per day.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Rapid Pheromone Recovery

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Redirect Attention
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Through your strong connection with your progenitor, you're able to redirect those attempting to spy on you.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Through your strong connection with your progenitor, you're able to redirect those attempting to spy on you. Whenever you would be directly targeted with a scrying effect, the effect must attempt a counteract check against the higher of your spell DC or class DC. If the check fails, the effect targets your progenitor instead of you.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Redirect Attention

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Scrutinizing Gaze
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Sense Motive when trying to determine if a creature is possessed or under the influence of an effect that would make them controlled, a +2…
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Sense Motive when trying to determine if a creature is possessed or under the influence of an effect that would make them controlled, a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks made to see through disguises worn by undead, and a +2 circumstance bonus when using the Seek action to find hidden or undetected haunts or undead within 30 feet of you.

If you aren't using the Seek action or searching, the GM automatically rolls a secret check for you to notice haunts or undead within 30 feet anyway. This check doesn't gain the usual +2 circumstance bonus, and instead takes a –2 circumstance penalty.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Scrutinizing Gaze

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Sea Witch
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've studied the waves, and they obey your will as extensions of your own fin.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've studied the waves, and they obey your will as extensions of your own fin. You can cast Aqueous Orb and Control Water as 5th-rank primal innate spells, each once per day.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Sea Witch

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Sharpened Senses
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your senses have become so sharp that you notice changes subconsciously.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per round

Your senses have become so sharp that you notice changes subconsciously. You Seek. If you use one of your senses from Natural Senses, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Sharpened Senses

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Shift the Little Ones
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: With your large size, you need to be careful around your smaller friends.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: With your large size, you need to be careful around your smaller friends. You have learned to move in such a way that it gives others the chance to make room for you. Stride up to your Speed. If you end your movement in a position where one or more of your spaces are occupied by an ally, each of those allies can immediately Step as a free action so that they are no longer occupying the same space as you. If this isn't possible, you must end your movement so that you aren't sharing a space with an ally, as normal.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Shift the Little Ones

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Smoothing Stomp
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You stomp and unleash a wave of the magic of creation in a 30-foot emanation that transforms non-magical difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain into normal terrain.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You stomp and unleash a wave of the magic of creation in a 30-foot emanation that transforms non-magical difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain into normal terrain. This terrain transformation remains in place for 1 minute, after which the terrain returns to its original state.

Your stomp can also counteract magical difficult terrain and magical greater difficult terrain. Your stomp's counteract rank equals half your level (rounded up), and for the roll, use either your class DC – 10 or your spellcasting attribute modifier plus your spellcasting proficiency bonus. If you successfully counteract the triggering effect, you suppress the effect for 1 minute, after which the effect returns if its duration hasn't expired.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Smoothing Stomp

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Swift Eel Mount
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your rapport with your eel lets you guide it to avoid dangers as it swims.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your rapport with your eel lets you guide it to avoid dangers as it swims. While you're mounted on an eel, that eel ignores difficult terrain while Swimming and gets a +2 circumstance bonus to all defenses against reactions triggered by its movement.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Swift Eel Mount

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Threatening Pursuit
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You emit a terrifying growl and snort, stamping your hooves for all to hear so that they know that you hunt them.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Requirements** You are not observed by any enemies within 60 feet.

You emit a terrifying growl and snort, stamping your hooves for all to hear so that they know that you hunt them. Attempt an Intimidation check to Demoralize all enemies within 30 feet, and you do not take a penalty for not sharing a language. If the targets are in a maze or similarly difficult-to-navigate location, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check, and the range increases to 60 feet. Each target is temporarily immune for 1 hour.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Threatening Pursuit

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Trample (Centaur)
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've trained to stampede right over smaller foes without causing yourself any harm.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've trained to stampede right over smaller foes without causing yourself any harm. Stride up to double your Speed; you can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, Trampling each creature whose space you enter. You can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single Trample. You deal bludgeoning damage equal to your hoof attack (or your unarmed strike if you lack a hoof attack) against these creatures, who can attempt a basic Reflex save against your class DC.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Trample (Centaur)

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Awakened Stride
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You blend your instinct and intellect to move so fast you seem to be a blur.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You blend your instinct and intellect to move so fast you seem to be a blur. When you use Wild Stride, you can Stride three times, and you're concealed during the movement.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Awakened Stride

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Axial Recall
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You have reconfigured the magical resonance of your core to attune to the planar energies of the plane of law, enabling instantaneous travel to that plane.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You have reconfigured the magical resonance of your core to attune to the planar energies of the plane of law, enabling instantaneous travel to that plane. You can cast Interplanar Teleport twice per week as an arcane innate spell that can only target yourself; you can travel only to the plane of law or the universe, and your body serves as the focus component.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Axial Recall

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Begin Stampede
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: The sight of you charging forward into battle emboldens your allies to follow.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: The sight of you charging forward into battle emboldens your allies to follow. You Stride up to twice your Speed and make a horns melee Strike. If your Strike hits and damages an enemy, each ally within 60 feet who saw you hit can use a reaction to Stride up to twice their Speed, but each must end their Stride closer to you than where they started. Each such ally that Strides gains a +1 status bonus to their first Strike on their next turn.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Begin Stampede

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Channel the Godmind
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You tap into the collective consciousness of the Godmind, the governing entity of axiomite society, to rapidly parse near-infinite variables to read your surroundings.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You tap into the collective consciousness of the Godmind, the governing entity of axiomite society, to rapidly parse near-infinite variables to read your surroundings. For 1 minute, you gain precise motion sense out to 60 feet, you can see invisible creatures and objects, and you gain the benefits of Truesight (with a counteract check modifier equal to your Perception modifier).
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Channel the Godmind

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Coral Lifeline
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your coral symbiotes have grown into your bloodstream and are now curled around your heart.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

Your coral symbiotes have grown into your bloodstream and are now curled around your heart. When you would die, the coral in your body releases a burst of healing energy. This prevents you from dying and restores 4d8 Hit Points. Once this ability is used, the coral fades to a dull gray and gives you no benefits until you complete your next daily preparations.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Coral Lifeline

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Core Cannon
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your body transforms into a powerful magical cannon.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

Your body transforms into a powerful magical cannon. While immobile as a cannon, you can fire blasts of energy directly from your core, devastating your foes. You become immobilized until you use an Interact action to revert back to your standard form. While in your cannon form, the only actions you can use are to Strike with an energy blast unarmed attack or to Interact to revert back to your standard form. You can remain in your cannon form for up to 1 minute or until you take the action to revert back to your standard form, whichever comes first.

Energy blasts are a special ranged unarmed attack. You can only make energy blast Strikes while you're in your cannon form. Your energy blasts deal 3d8 fire damage and 3d6 force damage, which increases to 4d8 fire damage and 3d6 force damage at level 20. You gain the item bonus to attack rolls with your energy blasts from the highest potency rune on any Handwraps of Mighty Blows you are wearing or any weapon you are wielding, but striking and property runes have no effect on your energy blasts. Energy blasts have a range increment of 120 feet. On a critical hit with an energy blast, the target takes 10 persistent fire damage. Your energy blast doesn't add critical specialization effects. If it matters for an effect dependent on weapon damage dice, an energy blast's number of weapon damage dice is three, or four at level 20.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Core Cannon

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Doom of Sailors
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.traits: auditory, concentrate, emotion, fear, mental, merfolk, primal
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Sailors know that the sight of an angry merfolk might well mean that they never see the shore again.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

Sailors know that the sight of an angry merfolk might well mean that they never see the shore again. You sing a song that foretells the fate of a creature you can see within 60 feet. The fear that grips the target's soul causes 10d10 mental damage, depending on the target's Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature who's in the water or onboard a seagoing vessel takes a –4 circumstance penalty to its saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes half damage and is Frightened 1 as it glimpses its demise.

**Failure** The target takes full damage and is frightened 1. In addition, it rolls twice for all skill checks and saving throws it attempts until the end of its next turn and takes the worse result; this is a misfortune effect.

**Critical Failure** As failure, except double damage and Frightened 2.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Doom of Sailors

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Fearsome Form
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: A fearsome illusion covers you, evoking the terror of the most dangerous animals.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: A fearsome illusion covers you, evoking the terror of the most dangerous animals. You can cast Mask of Terror as a primal innate spell once per day. You can target only yourself, and your appearance is always a monstrous version of yourself.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Fearsome Form

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Forge-Blessed Shot
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: On your next Strike with a ranged weapon before the end of your turn, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your attack roll and ignore your target's concealed condition, as well as your target's…
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You attempt a ranged Strike.

On your next Strike with a ranged weapon before the end of your turn, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your attack roll and ignore your target's concealed condition, as well as your target's lesser, standard, and greater cover.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Forge-Blessed Shot

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Greater Augmentation
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've greatly improved your abilities and your core can support further augmentations.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've greatly improved your abilities and your core can support further augmentations. You gain the enhancement benefits of one of your 1st-, 5th-, 9th-, or 13th-level automaton ancestry feats. You are also capable of reconfiguring your augmentations to meet your needs. You can spend one week of downtime to change the enhancement you gain with this feat.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Greater Augmentation

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Into the Labyrinth
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Calling on your connection to minotaurs of myth, you shunt an enemy into a complex maze full of puzzles of your own devising.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Calling on your connection to minotaurs of myth, you shunt an enemy into a complex maze full of puzzles of your own devising. Once per day, you can cast Quandary as an 8th-rank occult innate spell, which takes the form of a labyrinth instead of a puzzle room. Targets cannot attempt to use Occultism to escape the spell (as normal for *quandary*), but they can use Survival to find their way through the labyrinth's corridors.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Into the Labyrinth

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Jotun's Heart
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You have unlocked the power of a true giant within you.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
You have unlocked the power of a true giant within you. Your size becomes Huge. You have a 10-foot reach. Your maximum Hit Points increase by your level.

**Special** When you enter Jotun's Battle Stance, instead of its previous effects, it now increases the reach of any weapon you are wielding, or your fist unarmed attack, by 5 feet.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Jotun's Heart

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Jotun's Transposition
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've learned to fully move across planes, beginning with the Ethereal Plane.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've learned to fully move across planes, beginning with the Ethereal Plane. You can cast Interplanar Teleport twice per week as an occult innate spell that can target only yourself. Your body serves as the locus for the spell and allows you to travel between the Ethereal Plane, the universe, or the space between the planes known as the Fray without needing a planar key. You can use these castings to travel to other planes if you have the appropriate planar keys, as normal.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Jotun's Transposition

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Kraken's Call
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You call forth the sleeping krakens of the deep to crush your enemies.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You call forth the sleeping krakens of the deep to crush your enemies. You open a dozen small portals to some lightless, watery abyss in a 30-foot burst within 120 feet. The powerful tentacles of a kraken reach through to grab at each creature in the area. Each affected creature takes 8d6 untyped damage depending on its Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You can Sustain the call up to 1 minute. The first time you Sustain it on each subsequent turn, each creature in the area not already grabbed by the tentacles must attempt the save.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is grabbed by a tentacle. A creature that's still grabbed by a tentacle at the end of its turn takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage. The tentacles' Escape DC and AC are both equal to the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature can attack a tentacle to attempt to free the creature trapped by it; a tentacle is destroyed if it takes 30 or more damage in a single round.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but double damage.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Kraken's Call

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Merge with the Source
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.prerequisites: budding speaker centaur heritage or Speaker in Training
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You're among the most powerful of Speakers and can adopt the form of the spirits you entreat with.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You're among the most powerful of Speakers and can adopt the form of the spirits you entreat with. Select one of the following spells, which you can cast once per day as a 7th-rank innate spell. If you're a Faithspeaker, select from Angel Form, Daemon Form, Demon Form, or Devil Form, which you cast as a divine spell; if you're a Greenspeaker, select from Elemental Form or Plant Form, which you cast as a primal spell.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Merge with the Source

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Moray Ambush
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Like the moray eels athamaru communities raise and train, you know how to quickly strike from hiding.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Trigger** You are hidden and a creature who hasn't detected you passes within 20 feet of you.

Like the moray eels athamaru communities raise and train, you know how to quickly strike from hiding. Stride or Swim directly toward the triggering creature and make a melee Strike against it. The target creature is off-guard to this attack.

**Special** If you're mounted on an eel, you can have the eel move instead of yourself.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Moray Ambush

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Nodal Regeneration
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: Your body processes magic so effectively that you can induce true regeneration, replacing limbs and restoring organs.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: Your body processes magic so effectively that you can induce true regeneration, replacing limbs and restoring organs. You can cast Regenerate once per day as an innate spell. Instead of being deactivated by acid or fire, your regeneration from the spell is deactivated by cold, which slows your metabolism. You can target only yourself with the spell, but you can Cast the Spell as a reaction if you're reduced to 0 Hit Points by a non-cold effect.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Nodal Regeneration

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Offensive Odor
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You've mastered your defensive pheromones and have nearly complete control over them.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You've mastered your defensive pheromones and have nearly complete control over them. When you Emit Defensive Odor, you can either choose to increase the damage dealt to a single target by changing the damage dice to d8s (level-based poison), or leave the damage unchanged but spray your pheromones in a 15-foot cone.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Offensive Odor

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Pandemonium Eruption
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You unleash the pent-up chaos within you, becoming a nexus of unbridled destruction that wreaks unfettered havoc on everyone in your vicinity.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You unleash the pent-up chaos within you, becoming a nexus of unbridled destruction that wreaks unfettered havoc on everyone in your vicinity. Each creature within 15 feet of you takes 14d6 acid, electricity, or sonic damage, chosen randomly for each target. Each target receives a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC, but any creature that is subjected to the type of damage for which you currently have resistance through your Proteankin lineage takes a –2 penalty to the save. Any target that critically fails the save is also confused until the end of their next turn.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Pandemonium Eruption

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Planar Traveler
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You concentrate on the spaces between planes, allowing you to enhance your movement for a short period.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** Your turn begins.

You concentrate on the spaces between planes, allowing you to enhance your movement for a short period. Your Strides become augmented until the end of your turn, allowing you to instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Speed instead of traversing normally to the location. While augmented, your Strides gain the teleportation trait. Your augmented Strides don't trigger reactions that can be triggered by move actions or upon leaving or entering a square, unless those reactions are specifically triggered by teleportation.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Planar Traveler

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Reflect Foe
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: You create a copy of a foe by calling them forth from a nearby reflection, clonally growing them in an instant from one of your hairs or otherwise creating them in a way that matches your own nature…
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: You create a copy of a foe by calling them forth from a nearby reflection, clonally growing them in an instant from one of your hairs or otherwise creating them in a way that matches your own nature as a reflection. You can cast Duplicate Foe once per day as an innate occult spell. At 20th level, your innate *duplicate foe* is heightened to 8th rank.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Reflect Foe

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: Starshot Arrow
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: The greatest centaurs need not wait until their stories are over to touch the stars in the sky.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description:
The greatest centaurs need not wait until their stories are over to touch the stars in the sky. You draw an arrow (or other ammunition), whisper a short invocation over it, and then Strike with a ranged weapon. The arrow becomes a bolt of starlight, changing its damage to your choice of force or spirit and granting it the effects of the *Ghost Touch* rune. When the arrow Strikes its target, it unravels into a constellation of starlight that wraps around the target's limbs, imposing a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 2d4 rounds or Immobilizing it if the Strike was a critical hit. The target can untangle itself by spending an Interact action to break free.

Effect: Starshot Arrow
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Starshot Arrow

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: System Override
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.summary: When someone takes control of your consciousness or your body, you innately resist their domination with everything you have.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.description: When someone takes control of your consciousness or your body, you innately resist their domination with everything you have. At the beginning of your turn, if you have the controlled condition, you must attempt a DC 11 flat. On a success, you ignore the controlled condition for 1 round.
pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: System Override

pf2e-orc.feats.ancestry.name: True Senses
