Although the divinations of a haruspex traditionally require organs and lengthy interpretation, you've learned how to glimpse the future in a more simple fashion by reading creatures' wounds. The glimpse of the future gives guidance on what tools are best to use next. Roll 1d12 to determine the damage type favored by your prediction. The next time before the end of your next turn that you or your allies deals that damage type to an enemy, that enemy has weakness equal to your level against that damage.

Effect: Portents of the Haruspex

| D12 | Damage Type |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | acid |
| 2-3 | bludgeoning |
| 4 | cold |
| 5 | electricity |
| 6 | fire |
| 7 | mental |
| 8-9 | piercing |
| 10 | poison |
| 11-12 | slashing |
pf2e-orc.feats.class-witch.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Portents of the Haruspex

pf2e-orc.feats.class-witch.name: Wild Witch's Armaments
pf2e-orc.feats.class-witch.summary: Your patron's power continues to enhance your natural offensive capabilities.
pf2e-orc.feats.class-witch.description:
Your patron's power continues to enhance your natural offensive capabilities. You gain additional effects for any of the unarmed Strikes you chose from Witch's Armaments. If you took that feat multiple times to gain multiple attacks, you gain the appropriate additional effects.

- **Eldritch Nails** Your nails can tear and rend with the force of a beast. If you hit the same enemy with two consecutive nails Strikes, that enemy takes additional slashing damage equal to half your level on the second Strike.
- **Iron Teeth** Like a true predator, your teeth can crunch bone. A creature that you critically hit with a jaws Strike must succeed at a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or become Sickened 1.
- **Living Hair** Part of your hair hardens into sharp quills that you can eject with force. You gain a quills ranged unarmed strike that deals 1d4 piercing damage with a range of 15 feet. Your quills are in the dart group.
pf2e-orc.feats.class-witch.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Wild Witch's Armaments

pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.name: Elemental Defense
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.summary: You attune yourself to elemental power so that you gain a burst of protection when you call upon it.
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.description: You attune yourself to elemental power so that you gain a burst of protection when you call upon it. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has at least one element trait (air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood), you gain resistance to effects that have the element traits of your spell equal to twice the spell's rank. The resistance lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.name: Incriminating Spell
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.summary: You can attempt to blame someone else for your attempt to modify a target's mind.
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.description: You can attempt to blame someone else for your attempt to modify a target's mind. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell with the mental trait, choose a creature within 60 feet that the target can sense. The target will think that creature, instead of you, attempted to alter its mind when it succeeds at its save. If the target attempts to Sense Motive on either you or the incriminated creature, they must compare the results to your spell DC instead of the target's Deception DC. If the incriminated creature is obviously incapable of using magic, the target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their perception check to Sense Motive.

pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.name: Shrink Spell
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.summary: You've learned to manipulate space to narrow the impact of other spells.
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.description: You've learned to manipulate space to narrow the impact of other spells. When you use Counterspell to attempt to counteract a spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and does not have a duration, you reduce the area of the spell if you fail to counteract it. Remove 5 feet from the radius of a burst or emanation or 10 feet from the length of a cone or line.

pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.name: Knockback Spell
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.summary: You imbue your spells with magical force to knock creatures back.
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.description: You imbue your spells with magical force to knock creatures back. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, emanation, or line; has no duration; and requires creatures to attempt a Reflex or Fortitude save, the spell unleashes a forceful blast that pushes creatures away, in addition to its other effects. Each creature that failed its save against the spell is pushed 5 feet, and those who critically failed are pushed 10 feet. If the spell is a cone, emanation, or a line, you push the creature away from yourself. If the spell is a burst, you push the creature away from the center of the burst.

pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.name: Spellbinding Speech
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.summary: All the time you've spent discussing esoteric theses and performing spell incantations has made your words magical even when you aren't casting a full spell.
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.description: All the time you've spent discussing esoteric theses and performing spell incantations has made your words magical even when you aren't casting a full spell. Choose a creature within 30 feet who can hear and understand you, and attempt an Arcana check against their Will DC. On a success, your seemingly mundane speech is laced with spellbinding magic, preventing your target from using reactions until the start of your next turn. Regardless of the result, the creature is temporarily immune to your Spellbinding Speech for 24 hours.

pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.name: Shared Focus
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.summary: Your magical expertise allows you to perform a metaphorical sleight of hand to manifest a Focus Point.
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.description: Your magical expertise allows you to perform a metaphorical sleight of hand to manifest a Focus Point. Choose a willing ally within 30 feet who also has a focus pool. The target gains 1 temporary Focus Point until the start of your next turn, at which time it's lost, even if not spent. This temporary Focus Point is separate from the Focus Points in their focus pool, allowing them to have it even if they're at their pool's maximum. The creature then becomes temporarily immune to Shared Focus until their next daily preparations.

pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.name: Spatial Awareness
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.summary: Your study of different planes of existence makes you more attuned to teleportation effects.
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.description:
Your study of different planes of existence makes you more attuned to teleportation effects. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus when you attempt to counteract a teleportation effect.

When a teleportation effect occurs within 60 feet of you, you detect the location of the effect as a precise sense. If the effect is a creature teleporting away from that space, you know the general direction of the location to which it teleported but not the distance. However, you can attempt to Identify Magic within an hour of the teleportation to know the location to which the creature teleported within 10 miles on a success or 1 mile on a critical success.

pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.name: Redirect Teleportation
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.summary: You're able to intercept a teleportation effect and change where a creature appears.
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.description:
**Trigger** A creature teleports into a space within 60 feet of you.

You're able to intercept a teleportation effect and change where a creature appears. You expend a prepared spell that has the teleportation trait. You lose your spell slot as if you had cast the triggering spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell. The counteract rank for this effect is equal to the rank of the expended spell. If you succeed on your counteract check, you don't disrupt the spell. Instead, you choose an unoccupied space within 60 feet of you for the creature to teleport into. You can't choose a space that is obviously harmful (such as into a wall of fire or hazardous terrain) or would cause the target to fall.

pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.name: Dizzying Spell
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.summary: Your spell leaves a foe's head spinning and unable to concentrate.
pf2e-orc.feats.class-wizard.description: Your spell leaves a foe's head spinning and unable to concentrate. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that requires a Will saving throw and targets a single creature, the target is Stupefied 2 for 1 round if it fails its saving throw (or Stupefied 3 on a critical failure).

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Alter Ego Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You make yourself into a living mirror, becoming a double of someone unremarkable, and you slip into exactly the role that can get you past security or into a sensitive facility.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You make yourself into a living mirror, becoming a double of someone unremarkable, and you slip into exactly the role that can get you past security or into a sensitive facility. You become an expert in Deception. You gain the Assume a Role activity.

Alter Ego
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Alter Ego Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Animist Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You have formed a bond with an apparition and can cast divine spells.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You have formed a bond with an apparition and can cast divine spells. Choose a single apparition from those available to the animist. You become bound to that apparition and can attune to it each day during your daily preparations to become trained in its apparition skills. If you are 8th level, you are expert in its apparition skills while attuned to it, and if you are 16th level, you are a master in its apparition skills while attuned to it. You can spend 1 day of downtime ending your relationship with this apparition and bonding to a new one.

You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two common cantrips each day from the divine spell list or any other divine cantrips you have access to, including the cantrip listed in your apparition's apparition spells. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for animist archetype spells is Wisdom, and they are divine animist spells.

Animist
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Animist Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Artillerist Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Artillery is a team sport, where every member of the crew has to rely on the other members.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Artillery is a team sport, where every member of the crew has to rely on the other members. At best, a mistake might just waste time. At worst, a misaligned fuse or a badly set pin could cause the whole thing to explode. You've taken these lessons to heart, and so your presence on an artillery team assists the entire team at every aspect of the siege weapon's deployment and usage. If you're serving on a siege weapon crew, you and all other members gain a +2 circumstance bonus to any checks to Load, Aim, move, or Repair the weapon. When you Aim a siege weapon, you can move the weapon's aim twice as far as normal.

Artillerist
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Artillerist Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Avenger Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your training regimen has given you particular advantages when it comes to enforcing the interests of your faith.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Your training regimen has given you particular advantages when it comes to enforcing the interests of your faith. You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against divine spells and effects that deal spirit damage. You can use Religion to Coerce, Gather Information, or Track as long as you are in a town or city with a church dedicated to your deity, extracting clues from the faithful with displays of your piety.

Avenger
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Avenger Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Bloodrager Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Drinking powerful blood has awakened magical potential within you.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Drinking powerful blood has awakened magical potential within you. You gain a spell repertoire with two cantrips of your choice, from either the arcane or divine spell list. You choose these cantrips from the common spells for your tradition or from other spells you have access to on that tradition's spell list. At least one cantrip must require a spell attack roll. You're trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC. Your key spellcasting attribute for these spells is Charisma. Spells in your repertoire gain the rage trait while you are raging, and when you Cast a Spell from your repertoire, you become Drained 1 (or increase the value of your drained condition by 1); you can reduce the value of this condition only by Harvesting Blood (see below). You become trained in Arcana if you chose arcane cantrips or Religion if you chose divine cantrips. If you were already trained in this skill, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Harvest Blood action.

Bloodrager
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Bloodrager Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Bullet Dancer Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You mix guns and melee into a deadly art.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You mix guns and melee into a deadly art. You gain the Bullet Dancer Stance action. You are also granted familiarity with bayonets, reinforced stocks, martial firearms, and martial combination weapons; for the purposes of proficiency and abilities from this archetype, you treat bayonets, reinforced stocks, martial firearms, and martial combination weapons as simple weapons. You gain access to uncommon combination weapons that have a firearm ranged form.

**Bullet Dancer Stance** ◆ (stance)

Bullet Dancer
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Bullet Dancer Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Captain Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Charisma +2; you don't have an animal companion, construct companion, or other companion that functions similarly
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You become trained in your choice of Diplomacy or Intimidation; if you are already trained in both of these skills, you become trained in a skill of your choice.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You become trained in your choice of Diplomacy or Intimidation; if you are already trained in both of these skills, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain your choice of the Group Impression or the Group Coercion skill feat. If you already have both of these skill feats, you gain another 1st-level skill feat for which you qualify.

You also gain the assistance of a dedicated follower, who has agreed to accompany you on your journeys. They have the minion trait and begin as a novice follower.

**Special** Once you have a follower, you can never take a feat or class feature that grants an animal companion or another companion that prevents you from having an animal companion.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Captain Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Captivator Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Charisma +2; trained in Deception or Diplomacy
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your ability to captivate others borders on the preternatural.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Your ability to captivate others borders on the preternatural. You're seldom at a loss in social situations, and you can create minor charms or illusions. Choose Deception or Diplomacy. You become trained in that skill or become an expert if you were already trained.

Choose two cantrips from the occult list. Each cantrip must have the illusion trait, mental trait, or both. You can cast these spells as innate occult spells.

Captivator
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Captivator Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Chronoskimmer Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You became partially unstuck from time and have learned how to manipulate your place in the flow of time.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You became partially unstuck from time and have learned how to manipulate your place in the flow of time. When you roll initiative, you can choose one of three options: either do nothing and roll initiative normally, stabilize your timestream, or destabilize your timestream and send it into intense fluctuations.

- **Stabilize your Timestream** (fortune) You don't roll initiative, and instead your initiative is equal to 10 + the modifier you would have used for initiative.
- **Destabilize your Timestream** (fortune) You don't roll initiative, and instead attempt a DC 11 flat. On a success, your initiative is equal to 19 + the modifier you would have used for initiative, and on a failure, your initiative is equal to 1 + that modifier.

Additionally, if your initiative roll result is tied with an opponent's initiative roll, you go first.

Your manipulation of time grants you access to a number of abilities, some of which require a saving throw. The DC for these abilities is either your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, and is called your chronoskimmer DC

Chronoskimmer
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Chronoskimmer Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Clawdancer Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: permanent unarmed claw or talon attack (such as one granted by your ancestry or a graft)
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've practiced the art of fighting with your natural claws, hooking them into prey and thrashing at targets surrounding you.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You've practiced the art of fighting with your natural claws, hooking them into prey and thrashing at targets surrounding you. You gain the following two actions, which let you assume specific stances to strike more effectively with your claws.

Claw Stance

Talon Stance

Clawdancer
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Clawdancer Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Commander Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain the tactics class feature like a commander and gain your own folio; this folio contains two common mobility or offensive tactics of your choosing.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You gain the tactics class feature like a commander and gain your own folio; this folio contains two common mobility or offensive tactics of your choosing. You can prepare one of these tactics whenever a commander would be able to prepare tactics. You gain a commander's banner that grants you a 30-foot aura for the purposes of using your tactics, but the banner does not grant the commander's banner bonus to Will saves and DCs against fear effects. You become trained in commander class DC and Warfare Lore; if you were already trained in Warfare Lore, you become trained in another Lore skill of your choice.

Commander
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Commander Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Crossbow Infiltrator Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You have mastered stealthy weapons that allow you to strike carefully from a distance far enough to avoid reprisal, yet close enough to confirm your kills.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You have mastered stealthy weapons that allow you to strike carefully from a distance far enough to avoid reprisal, yet close enough to confirm your kills. You have familiarity with the Gauntlet Bow, Hand Crossbow, and Repeating Hand Crossbow, treating the repeating hand crossbow as a martial weapon for the purposes of proficiency and the gauntlet bow as a simple weapon for the purposes of proficiency. If you're at least an expert in any of these weapons, you gain access to that weapon's critical specialization effect. You also gain the Infiltrator's Draw action.

Crossbow Infiltrator
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Crossbow Infiltrator Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Demolitionist Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You know how to set explosives to cause the maximum possible damage to buildings and other structures.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You know how to set explosives to cause the maximum possible damage to buildings and other structures. You become trained in Engineering Lore or become an expert in it if you were already trained. You gain the Set Explosives action.

**Set Explosives** ◆◆ (concentrate)

Demolitionist
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Demolitionist Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Exemplar Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: A spark of inherent divine power has lit itself within you.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
A spark of inherent divine power has lit itself within you. You become trained in martial weapons. You gain one ikon, the ability to use the ikon's immanence and transcendence actions and effects, and the Shift Immanence action. Because you have only a single ikon, when you Spark Transcendence, your divine spark recedes back to the depths of your soul and must be recalled with Shift Immanence to re-empower your ikon. You become trained in exemplar class DC.

Exemplar
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Exemplar Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Field Propagandist Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Charisma +2; trained in Deception and Diplomacy
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Having devoted your life to crafting propaganda, you know that winning the hearts and minds of soldiers can be a deciding factor in securing the successful outcome of a war.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Having devoted your life to crafting propaganda, you know that winning the hearts and minds of soldiers can be a deciding factor in securing the successful outcome of a war. You gain the Spread Propaganda exploration activity.

While you are not immune to propaganda, you are resistant to it. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC against attempts made by others to Lie to you. If you have the Lie to Me skill feat, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception DC.

You become trained in Society. If you were already trained, you become an expert instead.

Field Propagandist
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Field Propagandist Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Firework Technician Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've learned the secrets of making fire and sound bloom using black powder, metals, and paper.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You've learned the secrets of making fire and sound bloom using black powder, metals, and paper.

You become trained in Fireworks Lore or become an expert if you were already trained in it. You gain the quick alchemy benefits, creating up to 4 pyrotechnic versatile vials during your daily preparations. These vials have the fire trait and deal fire damage instead of acid. You can use pyrotechnic versatile vials only to throw as bombs, for the Launch Fireworks action or with Quick Alchemy to create fireworks consumables, including Doses or rounds of black powder, the Sparkler item, and other items determined by the GM. You can replenish your versatile vials during exploration the same way an alchemist can.

You can create fireworks displays to have distinctive effects you can use to make onlookers marvel and even to gain an advantage in combat. You gain the Launch Fireworks action and learn some basic effects. You can learn additional, more complex displays that use your versatile vials through other firework technician feats. These add a new fireworks display to your options for Launch Fireworks, each of which lists its number of actions and effects. The DC for Launch Fireworks is equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

**Special** If you have Quick Alchemy from another source (such as the alchemist class or multiclass archetype), you can use standard versatile vials to Launch Fireworks or create fireworks consumables. Each time you create a versatile vial, you choose whether it's a standard vial or pyrotechnic vial. Both types count toward your maximum number of versatile vials. You can replenish only pyrotechnic vials during exploration unless another ability lets you replenish standard versatile vials (such as the benefit of the alchemist class), in which case you can choose the type each time you replenish.

Firework Technician
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Firework Technician Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: First Frost
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: The gelid shard within your heart may sap your ability to feel and experience emotion, but it also lets you create and manipulate cold.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: The gelid shard within your heart may sap your ability to feel and experience emotion, but it also lets you create and manipulate cold. You learn to cast arcane spontaneous spells, and you gain a spell repertoire with the Frostbite and Frost's Touch cantrips. You're trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC. Your key spellcasting attribute is Charisma.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Treasure Vault (Remastered) — Feats: First Frost

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Guardian Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You become trained in Athletics; if you were already trained in Athletics, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You become trained in Athletics; if you were already trained in Athletics, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You become trained in guardian class DC.

You become trained in light armor and medium armor. If you already were trained in light armor and medium armor, you gain training in heavy armor as well. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in any type of armor (but not unarmored defense), you also gain that proficiency in the armor types granted to you by this feat. If you have a class feature that grants you expert proficiency in unarmored defense and you're 13th level or higher, you also become an expert in the armor types granted to you by this feat.

You can use the Taunt action.

Guardian
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Guardian Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Guerrilla Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You're skilled in subtle tactics and using the environment against your enemies.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You're skilled in subtle tactics and using the environment against your enemies. You become trained in your choice of Deception or Thievery; if you are already trained in both, you become an expert in one instead. When you are in this location and undetected by all enemies, you can Sneak without attempting a Stealth check as long as you move no more than half your Speed. During exploration, this also allows you to automatically approach within 15 feet of other creatures while Avoiding their Notice, as long as they aren't actively Searching or on guard.

You can change your favored location by spending 1 week of downtime in the new location you would like to set as your favored location.

Guerrilla
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Guerrilla Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Gunslinger Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You excel in using specific types of ranged weapons.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You excel in using specific types of ranged weapons. You have familiarity with martial crossbows and firearms, treating them as simple weapons for the purposes of proficiency.

You gain access to uncommon martial and simple crossbows and firearms that do not have an ancestry trait. You become trained in gunslinger class DC.

Choose a gunslinger way. You become trained in your way's associated skill; if you were already trained in this skill, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You don't gain any other abilities from your choice of way.

Gunslinger
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Gunslinger Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Hedge Mage Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: The universe is your laboratory and altar, and the world your workshop and study.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
The universe is your laboratory and altar, and the world your workshop and study. Grounding your theoretical studies in honest labor, you work with the mundane to draw forth their hidden magic. When you take this dedication, choose Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion. You become trained in that skill, or you become expert if you were already trained. You also gain a keepsake that helps your magical studies; this keepsake is something that has perhaps been handed down to you but to which you've contributed a few personal touches, though it can be anything appropriate to your personal magical style. Sample keepsakes include a folio or binder of magical observations, a walking stick with mnemonic grooves, a bracelet of assorted charms and baubles, or a planchette carved into shape of a coffin. If it's destroyed or lost, you can create a new keepsake with 1 day of downtime.

You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for hedge mage archetype spells is your choice of Intelligence or Wisdom, and they are hedge mage spells of a tradition associated with the skill chosen for this dedication (arcane for Arcana, primal for Nature, occult for Occultism, and divine for Religion).

Your keepsake holds 4 common cantrips of your choice from your appropriate tradition. You prepare spells each day by meditating with your keepsake. You can prepare two cantrips from your keepsake each day. You can only add cantrips to your keepsake with the Learn a Spell activity or by other similar means.

Hedge Mage
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Hedge Mage Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Inventor Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You become trained in Crafting and inventor class DC.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You become trained in Crafting and inventor class DC. You gain the Inventor skill feat, even if you don't meet the skill feat's requirements. Choose an innovation. You gain that innovation, though you don't gain any other abilities that modify or use that innovation, such as modifications or Explode.

Inventor
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Inventor Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Living Nexus Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: trained in martial weapons; trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Whether through happenstance or hours of rigorous training, you have discovered within yourself the ability to breathe in the magic around you.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Whether through happenstance or hours of rigorous training, you have discovered within yourself the ability to breathe in the magic around you. You have an invisible, internal nexus of energy and have learned how to control your absorption of others' magical energy and store it in this internal nexus. You gain the Absorb Magic reaction and the Overflowing Blade action. The DC for an ability gained via this archetype is either your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, and is called your nexus DC.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Living Nexus Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Living Vessel Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Whether willingly or not, you've become a vessel for a being of unimaginable power.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Whether willingly or not, you've become a vessel for a being of unimaginable power. You and your GM should work together to determine the being's nature and decide how much you know and how much remains a mystery to you for now. Some decisions might influence your options later. You might need to decide whether the entity is a demon, for instance, to know if you qualify for later feats.

You need to spend at least an hour each day assuaging the entity within you or you take a –1 penalty to Will saves for 24 hours. The process of assuaging the entity is determined together between you and the GM. It might be as simple as meditating with the entity to learn more about them, but it might be as extreme as committing gruesome, unspeakable sacrifices to keep their unknowable blessings. After a full week of failing to assuage your entity, you become Doomed 1, and you can't remove or ameliorate the condition until you allow your entity to take full possession of your body for 24 hours, during which time it pursues its own agenda.

You also gain the Entity's Resurgence reaction, allowing you to unleash your entity in lieu of falling unconscious, though at the risk of letting it enact its will.

Living Vessel
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Living Vessel Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Mind Smith Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've learned to imagine a shape in your mind, to envision it so strongly it takes form in the material world.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You've learned to imagine a shape in your mind, to envision it so strongly it takes form in the material world. You gain a single melee weapon of your choosing, called a mind weapon. Your mind weapon is a martial melee weapon. The overall shape and design of your mind weapon can be of your choosing but it has one of the following four basic statistics:

- A one-handed weapon that deals 1d4 damage and has the agile and finesse traits
- A one-handed weapon that deals 1d6 damage and has the finesse trait
- A one-handed weapon that deals 1d8 damage
- A two-handed weapon that deals 1d10 damage and has the reach trait

Each day during your daily preparations, you can decide if you want your weapon to deal bludgeoning damage and be in the club weapon group, deal piercing damage and be in the spear weapon group, or deal slashing damage and be in the sword weapon group. Your mind weapon is an extension of your mind-it has no Hardness, and any ability that would damage your mind weapon instead damages you directly, pushing back against the weapon's corporeal form and becoming mental damage of the same amount the weapon would've taken.

You can project your mind weapon using an Interact action, just as you would draw any other weapon. Only you can hold, carry, or wield your mind weapon; if held by another person, it quickly disappears from their hand, reforming in your mind for you to project again. If you're disarmed of your mind weapon, it dematerializes, but you can draw it again with an Interact action starting at the beginning of your next turn.

Upon creating your mind weapon, you also learn to use a mind smith's keepsake: an object of light Bulk, such as a bracelet or figurine, that you wear or keep on your person and inscribe with weapon runes. Your keepsake can't be a magic item, nor can it have any significant monetary value beyond the value of any runes you inscribe on it. You can buy and inscribe fundamental runes and weapon property runes onto your keepsake in the same way you would for a regular weapon, and you can move runes to and from your keepsake to other weapons or runestones for the usual cost. Any runes inscribed on the keepsake apply to your mind weapon when you create it. If your keepsake is ever lost or destroyed, you can spend 1 week of downtime imprinting a new object with your weapon's mental properties, though this new keepsake won't have any of the runes that were inscribed on the prior keepsake.

Mind Smith
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Mind Smith Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Munitions Master Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You have drilled enough with your light mortar to operate it with unrivaled efficiency.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You have drilled enough with your light mortar to operate it with unrivaled efficiency. You gain the Engineer's Efficiency action.

Munitions Master (Class Archetype)
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Munitions Master Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Necromancer Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You can cast spells like a necromancer, gaining a dirge with four common occult cantrips of your choice.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You can cast spells like a necromancer, gaining a dirge with four common occult cantrips of your choice. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two cantrips each day from your dirge. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for necromancer archetype spells is Intelligence, and they are occult necromancer spells. You become trained in Occultism; if you were already trained in Occultism, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

Once per turn you can use a single action to create a single thrall within 30 feet. This action has the concentrate, manipulate, necromancer, occult, and thrall traits. You can use the Command a Thrall action as described in the thrall trait.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Necromancer Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Ostilli Host Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've bonded with an attached symbiote known as an ostilli.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Access** surki ancestry

You've bonded with an attached symbiote known as an ostilli. You can bond with only one ostilli at a time since the symbiote emits low-frequency magical pulses that repel other ostillis. You become trained in Ostilli Lore; if you were already trained, you become an expert.

The ostilli is a Tiny creature grafted to your body. Like other grafts, it has no Hit Points or Speeds of its own and can't be targeted separately. It can't be removed and dies when you do; in the event of your demise and resurrection, you can bond to a new ostilli during a week of downtime, though you lose any abilities granted by your ostilli bond during that time. Your ostilli is obvious, unless you attempt to cover it with clothing or armor. In such a case, an onlooker can determine you're bonded to an ostilli with a successful Nature, Perception, or Surki Lore check against your Deception DC. Your ostilli must be visible for you to use any of the actions it grants.

Your ostilli is constantly siphoning ambient magic from the surroundings, granting you the Repel Ambient Magic and Spit Ambient Magic actions.

Ostilli Host
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Ostilli Host Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Overwatch Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You have an innate knack for tactical observation, and you've innovated to apply that knack in a variety of ways that allow you to assist your allies.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You have an innate knack for tactical observation, and you've innovated to apply that knack in a variety of ways that allow you to assist your allies. With the help of enhanced visual gear (such as a specially modified telescope, goggled visor, or binoculars) and a set of carefully curated signals to share the information you uncover with your allies, you and your team are always keenly aware of the movement of combatants on the battlefield. You quickly and efficiently disperse the information you discover to your nearby allies so they can use it to direct their own observations and reactions to danger.

You're surrounded by an overwatch field aura in a 30-foot emanation. Your overwatch field aura grants you increased perception and allows you to call out warnings to your allies within the aura to point out threats. This aura has the auditory and visual traits. When you roll Perception for initiative, you and allies within your overwatch field receive a +2 circumstance bonus on your initiative rolls.

Effect: Overwatch Field

Overwatch
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Overwatch Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Pactbinder Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: trained in Diplomacy as well as either Arcana, Nature Occultism, or Religion
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: The first step toward forming a successful pact is an understanding of the magic behind it, along with skill at negotiation.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
The first step toward forming a successful pact is an understanding of the magic behind it, along with skill at negotiation. It doesn't hurt that you also learned how to magically bind yourself to keep your word, enabling you to bargain more easily. You increase your proficiency from trained to expert in Diplomacy and in one of the following: Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion. Many feats from this archetype involve swearing specific pacts. You typically can't retrain out of these feats.

You gain the Binding Vow action.

Pactbinder
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Pactbinder Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Pistol Phenom Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: trained in at least one type of one-handed firearm; trained in Deception; trained in Performance
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You catch an opponent off-guard by spinning your weapon.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You catch an opponent off-guard by spinning your weapon. You gain the Pistol Twirl gunslinger feat, enabling you to Feint against creatures within your weapon's first range increment. This otherwise serves as Pistol Twirl for the purpose of meeting prerequisites, although as normal, it doesn't count as another pistol phenom feat for the purpose of meeting Pistol Phenom Dedication's special entry and taking another archetype. Whenever you Feint with a one-handed firearm, you can choose to attempt a Performance check instead of a Deception check.

Pistol Phenom
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Pistol Phenom Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Psychic Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You feel something awaken within your mind.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You feel something awaken within your mind. You become trained in Occultism; if you were already trained in Occultism, you become trained in a skill of your choice.

You cast spells like a psychic and gain the Cast a Spell activity; as you don't have a subconscious mind class feature, your thoughtforms are simple intentions. Choose a conscious mind. You gain a spell repertoire with one standard psi cantrip of your choice from your conscious mind, which you cast as a psi cantrip.

You gain the normal benefits for this psi cantrip, but not any other benefits from the conscious mind. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for psychic archetype spells is the attribute you used to qualify for the archetype, and they are occult psychic spells.

Psychic
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Psychic Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Runesmith Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You become trained in runesmith class DC and Crafting.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You become trained in runesmith class DC and Crafting. You gain a runic repertoire with two 1st-level runes of your choice. You choose these from the common runes on the rune list as well as uncommon or rarer runes you have access to.

You can etch runes. An etched rune is carved, inked, or branded; this application does not damage the creature or item. Etching a rune requires an artisan's toolkit. Your magic can sustain up to one etched rune at a time. If you're at least 9th level, increase the maximum number of etched runes you can sustain at a time to 2, and if you're at least 17th level, increase it to 3. You can etch any number of runes up to your maximum during your daily preparations or by spending 10 minutes in exploration mode. Your etched runes remain indefinitely until they're expended or removed or until you etch more runes than your maximum, which causes your oldest rune to fade. Additionally, you gain the Solitary Invocation action.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Runesmith Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Seneschal Witch Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: As you work to understand the connection with your missing patron, it's increasingly easy to form bonds with those around you.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
As you work to understand the connection with your missing patron, it's increasingly easy to form bonds with those around you. Raw magical energy spills easily through the connection but, without a patron's control, it sometimes resists your demands for it to form proper spells.

You gain the Witch's Charge feat, but can't choose your familiar or another creature with the minion trait as a charge. When you cast or Sustain manifest will, as long as your charge is within 30 feet, you can choose to center the spell's emanation on your charge instead of yourself.

Seneschal
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Seneschal Witch Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Sniping Duo Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: trained in at least one type of weapon in the bow or firearm groups; trained in Stealth
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: When you take this dedication, choose one willing, non-minion ally to act as your spotter.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
When you take this dedication, choose one willing, non-minion ally to act as your spotter. This character does not need to specialize in ranged attacks; a melee partner can be just as effective and maybe even preferable depending on your preferred tactics and weaponry!

As part of your training in this archetype, you train your spotter in the necessary habits and techniques to use your abilities automatically; your spotter doesn't need to spend any feats of their own to grant the effects. You only gain the benefits of your Sniping Duo archetype feats if both you and your spotter are alive and conscious. You and your spotter don't grant your foes lesser cover against one another's Strikes. Whenever you or your spotter successfully Strikes a target, the other member of your duo gains a +1 circumstance bonus per weapon damage die on the damage roll of their next Strike made against that target before the end of their next turn. You can change your designated spotter by spending 3 days of downtime training with another ally to teach them your techniques and signals.

Effect: Sniping Duo Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Sniping Duo Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Soulforger Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: Wis +2 or ability to cast divine spells
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You can manifest the power of your spirit in combat to realize your motivations.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You can manifest the power of your spirit in combat to realize your motivations. You bind a suit of armor, shield, or weapon as a soulforged armament. Choose a motivation or cause known as a soul path that ties you to your soulforged armament; acting against or ignoring your soul path is anathema to you and could lead you to be afflicted with a curse called *soulforged corruption*. Choose one essence power for the armament. Changing an essence power requires 1 week of retraining, and you can't retrain them while you have *soulforged corruption*.

You can Manifest Soulforged Armament to summon your soulforged armaments in combat.

Soulforger

### ESSENCE POWERS

Your soulforged armament has an essence power you choose when you first bind an armament. It gains this power temporarily when you manifest its essence form. Each power has a specific corruption flaw that affects you if you have soulforged corruption. Essence powers that apply only to some types of armament indicate which.

**Adaptable Persona** Armor only. When you manifest the essence form, gain your choice of a climb Speed or swim Speed equal to your land Speed. If you're 8th level or higher, you can choose a fly Speed instead; Corruption Flaw You take a –10-foot penalty to all your Speeds.

**Bounding Spirit** Melee weapon only. The weapon gains the thrown 30 feet trait and has the returning rune (even if it has its maximum number of property runes); Corruption Flaw When you make a Strike with a thrown or ranged weapon and miss, reroll the Strike targeting your ally nearest to the original target. This Strike uses the same multiple attack penalty as the missed Strike and doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.

**Deep-Seated Fear** You gain a +2 status bonus to your Intimidation checks and don't take any penalties for not sharing a language when Demoralizing foes who can perceive your armament's essence form. When you Manifest the essence form, you can attempt to Demoralize an enemy who can perceive the manifestation as part of the action; Corruption Flaw If you attempt to Demoralize an enemy, it also targets the closest ally to you.

**Determined Toughness** Any status penalties you take from the following conditions are 1 less severe than their condition value would indicate: clumsy, drained, enfeebled, frightened, sickened, and stupefied. This doesn't change the actual condition value or any other effects of the condition (such as stupefied's disruption and its DC); Corruption Flaw Whenever you take a status penalty from the listed conditions, increase the condition's value by 1.

**Harmful Malice** (void) Your Strikes deal 1d4 additional void damage. You can cast harm once as an innate spell heightened to a rank equal to half your level rounded up; Corruption Flaw Reduce any damage you would deal by half your level.

**Heroic Heart** (mental) You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks; Corruption Flaw You take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls.

**Healing Grace** (healing, vitality) You gain fast healing equal to half your level. You can cast heal once as an innate spell heightened to a rank equal to half your level rounded up; Corruption Flaw Reduce any healing you would receive or grant with a spell by half your level.

**Magical Resilience** Armor or shield only. You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws and AC against spells. If you're 5th level or higher, you can cast dispel magic once as an innate spell. The dispel magic is heightened to a rank equal to 1 lower than half your level rounded up (2nd rank if you're 5th or 6th level, 3rd rank if you're 7th or 8th level, and so on); Corruption Flaw You take a –1 status penalty to saving throws and AC against spells.

**Planar Bond** Armor or shield only. When you manifest the essence form, choose one damage type: acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, spirit, vitality, or void. You gain resistance equal to your level + 2 to damage of the selected type; Corruption Flaw You gain weakness 1 to all damage.

**Planar Pain** Weapon only. When you manifest the essence form, choose one damage type: acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, spirit, vitality, or void. Attacks with the weapon deal this type of damage instead of their physical damage, with a +2 status bonus to the damage; Corruption Flaw When you deal damage with a weapon or unarmed attack, you take 2 untyped damage of the last type you chose for planar pain. You take this damage even if it's of a damage type that normally wouldn't harm you, such as vitality damage if you are living.

**Pull of Stasis** Weapon only. Any time you hit with the soulforged weapon, the target takes a –10-foot penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. On a critical hit, the creature is immobilized for 1 round instead; Corruption Flaw You take a –10-foot penalty to all your Speeds.

**Reflecting Spirit** Armor or shield only. You gain a +2 status bonus to AC against physical ranged attacks. If an enemy's physical ranged attack misses you, you can use your reaction to reflect the projectile back, dealing damage equal to half your shield's hardness to the attacker. The damage type of the reflected projectile is the same as type as the original projectile; Corruption Flaw You have weakness 5 to physical ranged attacks.

**Resolute Defiance** Shield only. The shield gains a +2 status bonus to its Hardness and temporary Hit Points equal to your level + 2 that last until the essence effect ends. If you don't have the Shield Block reaction, you gain it while your shield is manifested; Corruption Flaw When you take damage while you have a shield raised or use Shield Block, attempt a DC 5 flat. If you fail, the shield is Dismissed if it's your soulforged armament or Dropped if it's a different shield.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Soulforger Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Spellshifter Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You can exert your will over magical spells cast in your vicinity, potentially altering or controlling their effects.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You can exert your will over magical spells cast in your vicinity, potentially altering or controlling their effects. You accomplish this through the use of a spellshifting conduit, a magical object of your choice that has light Bulk and can be held in one hand. If your conduit is lost or destroyed, you can train yourself to use a new one by spending 10 minutes attuning yourself to it. You gain the Shift Spell action and the Share the Burden spellshift.

**Spellshift—Shift Burden** You share the burden of a spell, allowing you to share control with the caster. If Sustaining a spell with this spellshift causes a creature to attempt a saving throw, it is attempted against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If the spell requires a spell attack roll, make the attack using your Arcana modifier instead of the spell's normal spell attack modifier.

**Critical Success** If the spell is sustainable, you can Sustain the spell as a free action as though you had cast the spell. For the remainder of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the spell as though you were the caster.

**Success** If the spell is sustainable, you can Sustain the spell as a free action as though you had cast the spell.

Spellshifter
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Spellshifter Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Spellshot Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You cast arcane spells like a wizard, gaining a spellbook with four common arcane cantrips of your choice.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You cast arcane spells like a wizard, gaining a spellbook with four common arcane cantrips of your choice. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two cantrips each day from your spellbook. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for spellshot archetype spells is Intelligence, and they are arcane spells. You become trained in Arcana; if you were already trained in Arcana, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. This feat counts as Wizard Dedication for the prerequisites of Basic Wizard Spellcasting.

**Special** You can't select another dedication feat other than Beast Gunner Dedication until you've gained two other feats from the Spellshot or Beast Gunner archetypes.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Spellshot Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Sterling Dynamo Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You obtain a sterling dynamo prosthetic, which allows you to replace or augment a limb, or even add a simple new non-prehensile limb, such as a tail.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You obtain a sterling dynamo prosthetic, which allows you to replace or augment a limb, or even add a simple new non-prehensile limb, such as a tail. While your sterling dynamo prosthetic can replace a missing prehensile limb, such as an arm, choosing to add a new limb can never increases your character's number of hands or prehensile limbs beyond two, even in combination with other abilities or effects.

Your sterling dynamo prosthesis is especially optimized for combat, granting you a dynamo melee unarmed attack that is in the brawling weapon group and is made of silver (which makes it more effective against certain types of creatures, such as devils and werewolves).

You have several options to customize your sterling dynamo. First, choose whether you have a power driver dynamo, which deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage and has the shove trait, or a percussive striker dynamo, which deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage and has the agile and finesse traits.

Most dynamos are automated, so they don't require a free hand to use, like other unarmed attacks. However, you can instead choose to make your dynamo be manually controlled via a handheld switch, lever, or other device; to make an attack with a manually controlled dynamo, you must have a hand free to operate it, but the benefit is great control and a more devastating strike. This increases the damage die by one size, to a 1d8 for a power drive dynamo or 1d6 for a percussive striker dynamo. Arm dynamos are always manual, but they use the hand on that arm to operate the dynamo when making strikes. Manual control is required only in the heat of combat, not for less strenuous adventuring or everyday activities.

You need to keep your sterling dynamo wound, but the process isn't particularly onerous, so in most situations, it won't be an issue. If you spend 1 minute winding up your dynamo, it can remain active for 24 hours before needing additional winding. However, enemies can attempt to Disable the dynamo, which has a level equal to your own, to reduce the remaining operational time by 1 hour, or 2 hours on a critical success. Certain other abilities that adversely affect technology might also reduce the dynamo's remaining operational time. When your dynamo is out of operational time, you can still use it as a normal prosthetic, but you cannot use your dynamo unarmed attack or any other abilities from this archetype until you wind the dynamo again. You can wind the dynamo for 1 minute at any time to return it to the maximum 24 hours of operational time.

Sterling Dynamo
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Sterling Dynamo Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Summoner Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've formed a bond with an eidolon, an entity that manifests in a physical body only through their link to your life force.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You've formed a bond with an eidolon, an entity that manifests in a physical body only through their link to your life force. You gain an eidolon as well as the Manifest Eidolon activity. Due to your tenuous link, you can't gain or use tandem actions. Because you don't have Act Together, only you or your eidolon can perform an exploration activity at one time.

Your eidolon is trained in unarmed attacks and unarmored defense, and shares your proficiency rank for Perception, saving throws, and skill checks. Choose an eidolon type. You become trained in your eidolon's listed skills. For each of those skills that you're already trained in, you become trained in a different skill of your choice. Your eidolon's initial attributes are reduced. Instead of starting with a +4 attribute modifier in Strength or Dexterity and +2 in the other, your eidolon starts with a +3 in Strength or Dexterity and +2 in the other attribute. They otherwise gain the statistics listed for an eidolon of that type.

At 5th level, the eidolon's attribute modifier that was reduced to +3 increases to +4, before applying attribute boosts. At levels 5, 10, 15, and 20, your eidolon also gets four attribute boosts, which follow the same rules as yours.

Summoner
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Summoner Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Swarmkeeper Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your body has become a symbiotic hive for a swarm of crawling insects.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Your body has become a symbiotic hive for a swarm of crawling insects. You can emit your swarm using the Swarm Forth action, and you can use the Bite and Sting action while your swarm is outside your body to command it to attack. Your deep connection to your swarm precludes you from also having an animal companion, though if an ability allows you to have more than one animal companion (such as the beastmaster archetype), you can count your swarm as one. You're immune to any damage from your swarm, and during your daily preparations you can anoint up to five willing creatures with a concoction made from your pheromones to grant them immunity as well.

While outside your body, your swarm is Large and has a Speed of 15 feet and a climb Speed of 15 feet. It can occupy the same space as other creatures. While outside your body, the swarm can be attacked. It uses your statistics for defenses but is immune to grabbed, prone, restrained, and mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. The swarm has resistance equal to your level to physical damage and weakness equal to your level to area and splash damage. Any damage that would be dealt to the swarm is dealt to you instead, though you take damage only once from any ability that includes both you and the swarm in the area of effect (though you take the greater amount of damage).

Swarmkeeper
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Swarmkeeper Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Thaumaturge Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You've uncovered the hidden art of basic thaumaturgy.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You've uncovered the hidden art of basic thaumaturgy. You become trained in thaumaturge class DC. Choose an implement; you can use it to Glimpse Vulnerability, but don't gain its benefits. You also gain a few esoterica, allowing you to use esoterica actions. You become trained in your choice of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion; if you were already trained in these, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the Glimpse Vulnerability action.

Thaumaturge
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Thaumaturge Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Trick Driver Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You are equally at home piloting any vehicle, adapting yourself instantly to varied controls, movements, and handling.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You are equally at home piloting any vehicle, adapting yourself instantly to varied controls, movements, and handling. Whenever piloting a vehicle requires a Piloting Lore or Sailing Lore check, you can use your Driving Lore proficiency instead. You can use Dexterity in place of Intelligence when attempting piloting checks with Driving Lore. You become an expert in Driving Lore. At 7th level, you become a master in Driving Lore, and at 15th level, you become legendary in Driving Lore.

Trick Driver
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Trick Driver Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Ursine Avenger Form
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You draw the Ursine Avenger Hood over your head and its fur over your arms, assuming an ursine form that has traits of your original form as well as that of a bear.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You draw the *Ursine Avenger Hood* over your head and its fur over your arms, assuming an ursine form that has traits of your original form as well as that of a bear. In your ursine form, you gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage and a claws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage and has the agile trait. Both unarmed attacks are in the brawling group. You lose the ability to speak complex sentences while transformed and can only communicate through grunts and gestures; this prevents you from using effects that require a shared or spoken language until you revert back to your non-hybrid form. You can use this action while transformed to remove the hood and return to your original form.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Treasure Vault (Remastered) — Feats: Ursine Avenger Form

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Vehicle Mechanic Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You are adept at designing and maintaining mechanical vehicles, and you lavish your attention and ingenuity on one vehicle in particular.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You are adept at designing and maintaining mechanical vehicles, and you lavish your attention and ingenuity on one vehicle in particular. You become an expert in Crafting, and you choose one vehicle you own—or your party owns collectively—to be your signature vehicle: the vehicle you spend time customizing to grant it various advantages. You can spend 1 week of downtime with a new vehicle to designate it as your signature vehicle instead. Due to your amazing customizations and adjustments, pilots gain a +1 circumstance bonus to any piloting checks they make to control your signature vehicle. If you are a master in Crafting, this bonus increases to +2.

Vehicle Mechanic
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Vehicle Mechanic Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Veil Dancer Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You're able to shift yourself into the spaces between to avoid notice.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You're able to shift yourself into the spaces between to avoid notice. You gain the Part the Veil action.

Veil Dancer
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Veil Dancer Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Vindicator Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your church ensures that you are cared for.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Your church ensures that you are cared for. You can use Religion to Coerce, Gather Information, Make an Impression, or Request as long as you are in a town or city with a church dedicated to your deity. If the target of the check is also a worshipper of your deity or is your hunted prey, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check.

Vindicator
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Vindicator Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: War Mage Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: You have a spellcasting class feature.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your studies into the battlefield applications of magic have made your spells particularly effective at disrupting enemy formations or manipulating enemy troops into positions where they are more…
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Your studies into the battlefield applications of magic have made your spells particularly effective at disrupting enemy formations or manipulating enemy troops into positions where they are more vulnerable to wide-scale magical attacks. When you cast a non-cantrip spell that deals damage in an area, choose a number of targets equal to your Intelligence modifier who failed their saving throw against the effect. Move each one up to 10 feet from their original position after they take damage and any other effects from the spell. You can't move a creature into or through obstacles. A Medium or smaller creature counts as one target; a Large creature counts as two Medium creatures; and a Huge creature counts as four Medium creatures. You can't move Gargantuan creatures in this way.

You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Warfare Lore. If you were already trained in Warfare Lore, you become trained in a Lore skill of your choice.

War Mage (Class Archetype)
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: War Mage Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Warrior of Legend Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You have been given a powerful blessing of battle that is also your cursed doom.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You have been given a powerful blessing of battle that is also your cursed doom. As long as you aren't wearing heavy armor or wielding a shield, spears and polearms you wield gain the parry trait. If the weapon already has the parry trait, increase the bonus when parrying to +2. In addition, you deal an additional amount of damage equal to your doomed value with weapons in the spear and polearm groups. This damage is the same type as the required weapon.

Warrior of Legend
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Warrior of Legend Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Werecreature Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You're a werecreature, able to shift between your humanoid shape, an animal shape, and a monstrous hybrid of the two.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** You were born into a lineage of true werecreatures or were afflicted with the curse of the werecreature.

You're a werecreature, able to shift between your humanoid shape, an animal shape, and a monstrous hybrid of the two. You gain the beast and werecreature traits. Choose your werecreature type.

Once chosen, this can't be changed. You gain the Toughness feat but also a weakness to silver equal to half your level. You gain the Change Shape action. On the night of the full moon, you automatically use Change Shape to assume your hybrid shape, and you can't voluntarily activate or dismiss Change Shape until sunrise.

Werecreature

**Special** If you're a beastkin, you can use unarmed attacks from your hybrid shape while you're in your werecreature hybrid shape. These forms are otherwise separate.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Werecreature Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Wild Mimic Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Fighting in the wilds has honed your understanding of the unique abilities many creatures have.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Fighting in the wilds has honed your understanding of the unique abilities many creatures have. You're trained in Wild Mimic Lore, a special Lore skill that can be used only to Recall Knowledge about creatures to learn their abilities. If you have legendary proficiency in Nature, you gain expert proficiency in Wild Mimic Lore, but you can't increase your proficiency in Wild Mimic Lore by any other means. When you succeed at a Wild Mimic Lore to Recall Knowledge, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your saving throws against the next attack or ability that the subject of your Recall Knowledge targets you with.

Effect: Wild Mimic Dedication

Wild Mimic
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Wild Mimic Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Winged Warrior Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.prerequisites: you have permanent wings (such as from an ancestry or graft)
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Through rigorous training, you have strengthened your wings, granting you enough thrust to gain additional altitude.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Through rigorous training, you have strengthened your wings, granting you enough thrust to gain additional altitude. When you make a horizontal Leap, increase the distance by 10 feet up to a maximum of your Speed. Any fly Speed granted by ancestry feats and other permanent wings increases by 5 feet.

Winged Warrior
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Winged Warrior Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: World Rouser Dedication
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You know how to wake the world around you from its slumber, whether through your natural affinity for nature or hard-earned knowledge.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
You know how to wake the world around you from its slumber, whether through your natural affinity for nature or hard-earned knowledge. You gain the Rouse the World action.

As your ability to converse with the world grows, you can call on it to help you in other ways, some of which require a saving throw. The DC for an ability gained via this archetype is either your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, and is called your world rouser DC.

World Rouser
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: World Rouser Dedication

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Additional Follower
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Another follower joins you in your travels.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Another follower joins you in your travels. They are a novice follower that has the minion trait.

**Special** You can select this feat more than once, gaining an additional follower each time, to a maximum of four total followers.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Additional Follower

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Aether Blast
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You channel some of the raw magical energy in your internal nexus into a devastating blast.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** You are overflowing.

You channel some of the raw magical energy in your internal nexus into a devastating blast. You direct the blast at one creature within 30 feet, dealing (1d12 per 4 levels) force damage with a basic Reflex save against your nexus DC. The force damage increases by 1d12 at 8th level and every 4 levels thereafter. You are no longer overflowing.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Aether Blast

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Analyze Magic
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your intuitive understanding of magic allows you to read the energy of a spell in the air.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
Your intuitive understanding of magic allows you to read the energy of a spell in the air. You gain the Analyze Magic spellshift.

**Spellshift—Analyze Magic** Once you've homed in on a spell or magical effect, you can study its unique magical signature to immediately understand exactly what it does.

**Critical Success** You learn information about the spell or effect as if you had critically succeeded at a skill check to Identify Magic using the appropriate skill for its magical tradition.

**Success** You learn information about the spell or effect as if you had succeeded at a skill check to Identify Magic using the appropriate skill for its magical tradition.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Analyze Magic

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Animal Fleetness
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You're adept at using your animal shape's natural means of locomotion.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You're adept at using your animal shape's natural means of locomotion. While you're in animal shape, the Speeds granted by that shape increases by 10 feet.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Animal Fleetness

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Aphet Flash
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Each creature in its space must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or be dazzled for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical failure).
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description:
**Requirements** Your swarm is outside your body.

Each creature in its space must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or be dazzled for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical failure). The swarm then glows with light like a torch until it returns to your body.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Howl of the Wild — Feats: Aphet Flash

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Basic Animist Spellcasting
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits as a prepared divine caster.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits as a prepared divine caster. In addition to standard divine tradition spells, you can prepare your bonded apparition's apparition spells in your spell slots of the appropriate level from the animist archetype.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Basic Animist Spellcasting

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Basic Breakthrough
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level inventor feat of your choice.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level inventor feat of your choice.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Feats: Basic Breakthrough

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Basic Captivator Spellcasting
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your innate ability to fascinate others develops into full-fledged spellcasting.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your innate ability to fascinate others develops into full-fledged spellcasting. This spellcasting comes naturally and instinctively to you rather than as a product of training. Choose a 1st-rank occult spell that has the illusion or mental trait. You can cast this spell as an innate occult spell. At 6th level, you gain a 2nd-rank occult spell, and at 8th level you gain a 3rd-rank occult spell. These spells must also each have either the illusion or mental trait.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Basic Captivator Spellcasting

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Basic Death Dealing
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level necromancer feat of your choice.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level necromancer feat of your choice.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Basic Death Dealing

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Basic Defender
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level guardian feat.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level guardian feat.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Basic Defender

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Basic Field Training
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level commander feat.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level commander feat.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Battlecry! — Feats: Basic Field Training

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Basic Glory
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level exemplar feat.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level exemplar feat.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Basic Glory

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Basic Hedge Mage Spellcasting
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: Your independent introspections grant you rudiments of magical power.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: Your independent introspections grant you rudiments of magical power. You gain the basic spellcasting benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the hedge mage archetype, add three common 1st-rank spells to your keepsake. Your keepsake can also hold 1st-rank spells.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Basic Hedge Mage Spellcasting

pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.name: Basic Martial Magic
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level magus feat of your choice.
pf2e-orc.feats.archetype.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level magus feat of your choice.
